name: From Reels
description: Recipes saved from Instagram reels, each credited to its creator and linked to its reel.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Hard-Boiled Eggs
steps: Place the eggs in the air fryer and cook at 180C (about 355F) for around 7 minutes.
Remove with a tea towel and put into ice-cold water for about 3 minutes.
Peel the shells; the yolk will be gooey in the center.
recipes.notes: Creator says eggs come out hard-boiled with a gooey center. Recipe from Shayne Rowland on Instagram.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Baked Oatmeal
steps: Mash the bananas in a baking dish. Mix in the plant milk, nut butter, maple syrup and salt.
Stir in the oats, baking powder and chocolate chips.
Decorate with banana slices and a bit more chocolate.
Bake at 200C / 400F for 30-35 minutes and cool a few minutes.
recipes.notes: Serves 6-8. Recipe from @maya.plantbased on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
steps: Mix the cottage cheese, eggs, vanilla, syrup and self-rising flour into a batter.
Cook on medium heat in a muffin ring until fluffy.
Air fry the two ripe bananas with cinnamon (time and temperature not given) and serve on top.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Contains cottage cheese; Newt avoids cheese. Macros are the creator's estimate. Recipe from Noah Perlo on Instagram.

recipes.title: Easy Overnight Homemade Bagels
ingredients: 1 tsp neutral oil, for the proof
2 tbsp brown sugar, for the boiling water
steps: Combine warm water, yeast and sugar and let sit about 5 minutes to activate. Add the bread flour and mix.
Knead on a floured surface about 10 minutes until it springs back when poked. Roll into a ball, cut in two, poke a hole in each and stretch to 1-2 inches wide.
Put on a parchment-lined tray, drizzle with oil, cover with plastic wrap and a towel, and refrigerate overnight (up to 24 hours).
Preheat the oven to 400F. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil, lower to a simmer and add the brown sugar. Boil each bagel 1 minute per side.
Return to the tray, top with sesame seeds and garlic powder, and bake 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway.
recipes.notes: Makes 2 bagels. Full recipe at tifflovestofu.com. Recipe from Tiffany Bach on Instagram.

recipes.title: Eggplant Omelette (Tortang Talong)
steps: Method not given in caption; watch the reel for the cooking steps.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Silent video; steps are on screen only. Contains oyster sauce. Recipe from @verna on Instagram.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Ginger Shot Cubes (hot drink)
ingredients: 12 lemons, peel on, ends cut off
steps: Cut the ends off the lemons, leaving peel on, and peel the ginger.
Blend lemons, ginger, apple cider vinegar, pepper, turmeric, cinnamon and cayenne until smooth.
Fill ice cube trays (about four trays) and freeze.
Each morning drop one cube into a cup of hot water and drink.
recipes.yield: Makes 4 ice cube trays, about 2 months supply
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. She says lemon count first as a dozen and mentions 'six' limes/lemons unclearly; quantities of vinegar and spices not given. Skin benefit is a personal claim. Recipe from Marilyn Logan on Instagram.

recipes.title: High-Protein Pumpkin Swirl Pancakes with Whipped Cinnamon Butter
steps: Blend the oats, Greek yogurt, eggs, honey, vanilla and baking powder into a batter.
Cook the pancakes, adding a pumpkin cinnamon swirl.
Stack and serve with whipped cinnamon butter and maple syrup.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts; swirl and butter details not shown. Full recipe from the creator by DM or Google search. Recipe from Josh Gale (thechefoutwest) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Jacked Mango Smoothie
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth and thick.
recipes.notes: About 590 cal, 90g protein, $3.25 per serving (creator's figures; the audio says 95g). Recipe from Joseph Abell on Instagram.

recipes.title: Perfect Soft-Boiled Eggs
steps: Bring a pot of water to a ripping boil.
Gently lower the eggs in and set a timer for 7 minutes.
Prepare an ice bath while they cook.
When the timer goes off, crack each egg with a spoon as you put it in the ice bath.
After a few minutes, peel. Use 6.5 minutes for very runny or 7.5-8 for medium.
recipes.notes: Cracked eggs may leak but are still edible. Recipe from @Ali Hooke on Instagram.

recipes.title: Piaz Dagh Eggs (Persian Caramelized Onion Eggs)
steps: Cook the sliced onions, salting them at the start to draw out moisture.
Add turmeric and keep cooking well past regular caramelized onions until deep dark, intensely sweet and savory.
Add pepper and a little cumin.
Crack eggs into the onions and cook; eat straight from the pan.
Leftover piaz dagh keeps in the fridge as a flavor base.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts or times given; recipes are on cheffinwithzach.com. Recipe from @cheffinwithzach on Instagram (Zachary Neman).

recipes.title: Ramadan Date Shake
ingredients: 3 medjool dates, soaked in hot water 5 minutes
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for about 5 minutes.
Blend the dates with the banana, chia, cinnamon, coffee, almond butter, oats and milk for about 30 seconds until the dates break down.
Add ice cubes and blend to your preferred creaminess.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Quantities are on EatsByRamya website (eatsbyramya.com/recipes/ramadan-date-shake). Claims 15g fiber and 17g protein. Recipe from Ramya Ravuri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Soft, Medium and Hard Boiled Eggs
steps: Place eggs in a pot and cover with cool water.
Bring to a rolling boil, then put a lid on and take the pot off the heat.
Set a timer: soft 4 minutes, medium 6 minutes, hard 12 minutes.
Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 3-5 minutes.
Roll on a flat surface to crack the shell, peel and serve or refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Medium eggs come out almost jammy. Recipe from @kellyscleankitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Souffle Omelet and Chocolate Lava Cake
ingredients: butter, plus more for the ramekin
2 tbsp flour, plus flour for dusting the ramekin
steps: Omelet: separate 3 eggs. Whip the whites to stiff peaks. Mix a dollop of whites into the yolks, then fold into the rest of the whites.
Pour into a buttered non-stick pan, cover with a lid and cook on low 5-10 minutes. Fold in half and cook the other side briefly.
Lava cake: butter and flour a ramekin. Melt the chocolate with butter over a double boiler.
Mix the eggs, yolks, sugar, brown sugar, salt and vanilla, then stir in the melted chocolate and 2 tbsp flour.
Pour into the ramekin and bake at 450F for 11 minutes.
Turn out onto a plate and dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Egg and sugar amounts for the lava cake and butter amounts are not stated. Recipe from SauccEats on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spiced Tahini Granola
steps: Preheat the oven to 320F (convection) and have two sheet pans ready.
Combine the dry ingredients and mix well.
Heat the tahini, maple syrup, olive oil and vanilla in a small pot and mix thoroughly. Pour over the dry mixture and coat well.
Spread in a thin layer on the sheet pans and press firmly with the back of a spatula.
Bake 20 minutes, rotate the pans, and bake another 5-10 minutes, watching closely so it does not burn.
Cool completely before sampling, then store in jars.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Terianncarty on Instagram.

recipes.title: Vegan Brownie Baked Oatmeal
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F.
Mix the wet ingredients in a bowl, then add the dry ingredients and mix. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour into a 6x9 baking pan and bake 40 minutes.
Store in the fridge and reheat to serve.
recipes.notes: Vegan and gluten-free if the oats are certified. Recipe by @healthygirlkitchen, shared by Vegan Tips on Instagram. Caption also has a cookbook promo link.

recipes.title: World's Best Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: bread flour, added one cup at a time
steps: Cook a paste of water, milk and bread flour on the stove.

In a stand mixer combine warm milk, instant yeast, sugar, egg, salt, melted salted butter and the paste. With the mixer on low, add bread flour one cup at a time until a dough forms. Knead 15 minutes on medium speed.
Let the dough rise 1 hour, then roll it out.
Spread with softened salted butter, cover with brown sugar and cinnamon, press in, and roll up tightly. Cut into 10-12 rolls and place on a lined sheet pan.
Pour warm heavy whipping cream over the rolls and bake.
Cool about 5 minutes, then slather with cream cheese frosting.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts, temperatures or bake time in the reel; the full recipe is on her website or sent by DM. Frosting contains cream cheese. Can be made the night before (see her site). Recipe from Lauren Bower on Instagram.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Cherry Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water and reserve some pasta water.
Fry the garlic in olive oil, add the halved cherry tomatoes and a pinch of salt, and cook until they soften and break apart, pressing them down.
Add lemon zest and white wine and reduce by half.
Turn the heat off, add cold butter, turn the heat back on and stir until emulsified.
Add the cooked pasta and salty pasta water, then basil, parsley, parmesan and lemon juice, adding more pasta water until saucy.
Mix well and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe on his Substack. Contains parmesan; leave it out for a cheese-free version. Recipe from Bartek Michalski (Spoon Me) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Afghan Macaroni
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Heat olive oil or ghee in a large skillet; cook onion and garlic.
Add the ground meat, tomato paste and salt; cook through but keep juicy.
Mix the yogurt, sour cream, garlic and salt into a thick sauce.
Layer pasta, meat and garlic yogurt; finish with dried mint, parsley, paprika, cayenne, and chili butter if using.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Original uses beef and veal; could be made with another ground meat but that is not from the reel. Recipe from Neelo on Instagram.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Shawarma
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380F.
Slice the chicken and vegetables. Add everything except the naan and toppings to the basket and toss.
Air fry 16-18 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve as a wrap with tzatziki, tomatoes and cucumbers, or with rice.
recipes.notes: Caption does not say how the yogurt is used; presumably mixed in with the marinade. Recipe from @fooddolls on Instagram.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Tandoori Chicken
steps: Mix the yogurt with turmeric, pepper, coriander powder, Kashmiri chili powder, paprika, cumin, garam masala, ginger-garlic paste, kasuri methi, lemon juice, oil and salt until no lumps remain.
Slice the raw chicken a little so the spices can get in, then coat it completely.
Space the pieces out on a tray in the air fryer.
Air fry at 385F for 20 to 22 minutes, flipping at the halfway point.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts not given in the video. Can use any meat, or paneer. Authentic version uses a tandoor; the air fryer works as a substitute. Recipe from Sai Balaji | Food, Lifestyle & Travel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Basaliyeh (Lamb and Onion Rice)
ingredients: 1 kg onions, sliced (keep some for the sauce)
steps: Put the sliced onion, tomato, garlic and chilies in a pot and top with the lamb pieces.

Season with salt and add the whole spices. Cook on the lowest heat for 2-3 hours, until the meat is extremely tender. Check occasionally and add a few splashes of water if needed. A pressure cooker cuts the time by half or more.
Remove the lamb and broil it in the oven. Strain the stock.
Wash and soak the rice for 30 minutes, then add it to the pot with the stock so the liquid sits about 1/2 cm above the rice (add water if needed).
Bring to a boil; once the rice absorbs the stock, drop to a simmer, cover and cook 20 minutes.
For the sauce, blend the remaining onions with fresh garlic, chili and lemon juice, adjusting the thickness with water.
Serve the rice topped with the lamb and the sauce on the side.
recipes.notes: Sauce quantities are approximate (not given). Hearty cold-weather dish. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Broad Bean Maqluba (Maqluba Ful Akhdar)
steps: Boil the lamb with the cinnamon stick, bay leaves, onion and water about 1 hour until almost tender; keep the stock.
Saute the broad beans in olive oil until a bit toasty with salt, pepper, garlic and coriander; set aside.
Soak the basmati and Egyptian rice for 30 minutes.
Line the bottom of a pot with baking paper. Layer broad beans, then lamb pieces stacked tightly, then rice and the rest of the beans.
Season with salt, lots of black pepper and 1 tsp cinnamon. Add 4-5 cups liquid (about 3-4 cups lamb stock plus 1 cup water).
Bring to a boil, drop to a simmer, cover and cook 30 minutes. Rest at least 30 minutes, then flip onto a tray and serve with yogurt.
recipes.notes: Fresh broad beans would be better than frozen. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken with Garlic Butter Naan
steps: Mix the chicken with the marinade ingredients and marinate.
Make the naan dough: mix flour, yeast, salt, sugar, yogurt, oil and warm water; work until the gluten is strong, shape into a ball, cover with a damp towel and let double.
Fry the marinated chicken in a hot oiled pan until charred and golden on both sides; set aside.

Melt oil and butter, saute onions, then ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes. Add cumin, coriander, garam masala, salt and Kashmiri chili and cook to a paste. Add the nuts and water, simmer, then blend smooth.
Add the chicken cubes to the sauce to finish cooking. Stir in heavy cream, butter and fenugreek.
Punch down the dough, portion, roll and stretch into a hot dry pan until risen, then flip over open flame to char.
Melt butter with garlic and coriander and brush over the naan. Serve with the butter chicken.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities were given; this is a method outline from narration. Recipe from Ombachi Dennis on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cajun Butter Turkey
steps: Dry brine the turkey with kosher salt overnight.
Mix the Cajun compound butter, pat the turkey dry and stuff the cavity.
Rub the butter under the skin and all over the outside.
Add vegetables, white wine and chicken broth to the pan and roast about 1 hour.
Inject the turkey with Cajun butter and drape with cheesecloth dipped in Cajun butter.
Finish cooking until the turkey reaches 168F.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Full step-by-step recipe is on the creator's profile; no amounts in the reel. Recipe from @toniroasted on Instagram.

recipes.title: Caramelised Onion Butter Beans
ingredients: 1 can (400 g) butter beans, with liquid
steps: Heat a couple tbsp oil in a medium frying pan over medium heat and fry the onions, stirring often, until soft and caramelised.
Add the garlic and tomato puree and cook 2 minutes, stirring.
Deglaze with the wine and simmer a couple of minutes until mostly evaporated (skip if no wine).
Add the butter beans with their liquid.
Add the cream and simmer 5 minutes.
Squeeze in the lemon, season to taste, top with herbs.
recipes.notes: Uses cream, not cheese. Recipe from @carolehector on Instagram.

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion and Garlic Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup cream or coconut milk, room temperature
8 oz (225 g) pasta of your choice
steps: Bring cream or coconut milk to room temperature. Slice onion, mince garlic and measure seasonings.
Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook onions 15-20 minutes, stirring, until golden and jammy; add a splash of water if sticking.
Meanwhile boil salted water and cook pasta al dente; reserve some pasta water, then drain.
Stir garlic and all seasonings into the onions and bloom 1 minute. Add chili crisp and saute 1 minute.
Pour in cream or coconut milk and simmer a few minutes. Add soy sauce and grated Parmesan.
Toss pasta in the sauce, loosening with pasta water until silky.
Serve hot with extra chili crisp and parsley.
recipes.notes: Serve with chicken, shrimp or tofu. Skip Parmesan or use a vegan substitute to avoid cheese (not tested). Recipe from @64506271946 (Ben Chelin) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Chukani with Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed and soaked
steps: Sear the chicken cubes in ghee with salt, black pepper, a little red pepper, turmeric, cumin, coriander and ginger-garlic paste until deeply browned, then set aside.
Heat a little ghee in a pot, add whole spices, then the soaked rice, salt, the mixed spices and 2½ cups water.
When it boils and the grains open, lower the heat and let it steam covered for about 20 minutes.
Top the chicken with sliced onion, chopped chilies, plenty of coriander and the lemon juice.
Heat 2 tablespoons ghee with 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp red chili, pour it over a bowl of well-mixed yogurt, and stir.
Pour the yogurt over the chicken (warm it slightly if you want it hot).
Serve over the rice, garnished with coriander and green chili slices.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Narrated in Arabic (Gulf/Iraqi style) for Ramadan suhoor. The Arabic transcript is imperfect (chicken is misheard as 'daqaq'), so details like whole spices are approximate; ingredient list is from the caption. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Kebab with Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 3 tbsp Greek yogurt or laban (or mayonnaise)
steps: Combine the minced chicken with grated onions, garlic, chopped parsley and coriander, spices, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Shape into kebabs and cook (method and time not given in the reel).
Whisk the tahini with yogurt, water, lemon juice, paprika and salt for the sauce.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Creator also uses the mix for meal prep across the week. Cooking method not given; transcript is repetitive. Recipe from @omaryassin on Instagram (Omar Yassin).

recipes.title: Chicken Maqluba
steps: Cook the chicken for 20-25 minutes over medium heat.
Cook the rice until half done.
Fry the potatoes, eggplant and cauliflower in oil and set aside.
Saute onion, garlic and tomatoes with the tomato paste, mixed spices, turmeric, cumin and salt. Add water.
Layer the fried vegetables, chicken and bell pepper in the pot, then the rice, add water and salt, cover and cook until done.
Invert onto a platter.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. The caption was cut off after step 2 and Arabic audio is poorly transcribed, so amounts and times are unknown; the creator also asks viewers to correct mistakes. Recipe from Abdullah Almatrood on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Pelau (Trinidad & Tobago)
steps: Marinate the chicken in fresh herbs and spices for at least 24 hours.
Deeply caramelise the sugar in the pot.
Brown the chicken in the caramel, then add the pigeon peas, rice and coconut.
Cook the rice 10 to 15 minutes until almost cooked through.
Fluff once only, then cover and steam for 20 minutes.
Stir in coriander, spring onions and a dash of lime juice.
Serve with coleslaw and avocado.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts not given; the order of adding chicken after caramelising is implied, not stated. Creator prefers 'wet' pelau. Recipe from Xavier Bramble on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma (Home Version)
ingredients: up to 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil, added gradually
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips.
Mix all marinade ingredients together and coat the chicken well.
Refrigerate 2 to 4 hours, or overnight for best flavor; it can be used immediately in a pinch.
Spread the chicken in a hot pan and leave undisturbed until the underside is browned so the juices stay in.
For the garlic sauce, blend egg, garlic and salt, slowly drizzle in the oil, then add lemon juice.
Serve in toasted bread.
recipes.notes: Garlic sauce uses a raw egg. Transcript is partly garbled, so oil amount may vary. Recipe from @ali (ᗩᒪI) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Meatballs
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F.
Process everything in a food processor until well blended and cohesive.
Roll into meatballs and place on a parchment-lined or sprayed baking sheet. Lightly spray the meatballs.
Bake 20-25 minutes until cooked through and golden. (Air frying also works.)
recipes.notes: Recipe from @fooddolls on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Sandwich
steps: Slice the chicken breasts and mix with the spice mix, garlic, lemon juice and zest, and olive oil.
Marinate in the fridge about 2 hours.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan with oil.
Wrap in saj bread with toum, pickles and pomegranate molasses, and grill the wrap in the pan.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Whisper garbled the Arabic audio badly, so quantities and some steps are uncertain; check the video. Recipe from Molham | مُلهَم on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Wraps
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken thighs and breasts
steps: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, yogurt, garlic and shawarma spices with the chicken and massage in; marinate several hours.
Thread on a vertical spit or bamboo skewers and bake until the internal temperature reaches 165F.
Slice the chicken into strips.
Roll the dough thin into circles and cook on an upside-down heated pan.
Fill the bread with chicken, toum, pickles, pomegranate molasses and cabbage slaw.
Brush with leftover chicken juices, sprinkle with sumac and toast in a hot pan until crisp.
Serve with fries and extra garlic sauce.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe and her flatbread/toum recipes are on her website. Recipe from @nutrientmatters on Instagram (Sara, Nutrient Matters).

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Cube the chicken breasts and marinate with salt, pepper, red chili powder, cumin, turmeric, ginger garlic, yogurt and lemon juice. Marinate as long as you can.
Air fry the chicken at 380F for 10 minutes.

Dice tomatoes and red onions. Heat oil in a pan and add whole spices, then onions, ginger garlic paste, green chilies, tomatoes, cashews and cilantro. Cook about 20 minutes, blend, and set aside as the gravy.
In a pan, heat ghee with cumin seeds, red chili powder and turmeric. Add finely diced onions and tomatoes and cook down.
Add the gravy, then finish with butter, dried fenugreek leaves, salt, sugar and heavy cream. Add the chicken and simmer briefly.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given in the video; full recipe is at amateurprochef.com (link in bio). Recipe from Vimarsh Patel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala Burritos
ingredients: Spice mix (use half in marinade, half in sauce)
350 g chicken bone broth (optional, for cooking the rice)
steps: Mix the marinade ingredients with the chicken breast and marinate at least a couple of hours.
Melt 30 g butter, cook the onions over high heat until translucent and starting to brown, add garlic and ginger and saute 3-4 minutes.
Add tomato paste and half the spice mix and simmer 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes, water and cilantro, simmer 10-15 minutes, then blend until completely smooth.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, 15 g butter, cilantro and salt over low heat.
Grill the chicken until charred, about 10 minutes (or bake or broil); it should be slightly undercooked. Dice and add to the sauce, cover and simmer 15-20 minutes.
Cook the basmati rice in the bone broth, mix into the chicken and sauce, and refrigerate the filling about 20 minutes so it thickens.
Divide into 11 portions, roll in tortillas and freeze.
Mix the herby yogurt sauce ingredients for dipping.
To reheat: wrap in a paper towel, microwave 2 minutes, then air fry at 375F for 6-8 minutes (or pan fry) to crisp.
recipes.notes: Makes 11 burritos, about 480 cal, 40g protein, 56g carbs, 11g fat each (creator figures). Episode 2 of a frozen burrito series. Recipe from Tom Walsh (Stealth Health) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chicken, Andouille and Shrimp Gumbo
steps: Make a roux from flour and bacon grease, stirring until dark.
Add the onion, bell pepper and celery.
Add the cut-up chicken thigh and andouille and cover with stock.
Simmer until done, adding water if too thick.
Add the shrimp (and crab if using) at the last minute and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts. Bacon grease and andouille are pork. Recipe from @rappingchef on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chili Peanut Crispy Rice Salad with Honey Soy Salmon Bites
ingredients: 1.5 large English cucumbers, diced and dried
1 large avocado, cubed, salted and peppered
steps: Mix the rice with vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and fried chili; bake at 400F for 40 minutes, stirring every 10, until brown and crispy.
Marinate the salmon cubes in the soy, honey, sesame oil and seasonings at least 10 minutes, then air fry at 400F for 10 minutes.
Blend the dressing ingredients.
Toss the cucumbers, edamame, green onion, cilantro, avocado and peanuts with the dressing.
Top with the crispy rice and salmon.
recipes.notes: Transcript is a song; recipe is from the caption. Recipe from Audrey Rogers on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
steps: Blend the chipotles, garlic, lime juice, honey, salt, pepper, paprika, oregano, cumin, coriander and mushroom powder, streaming in oil to emulsify.
Mix a scoop of marinade with mayo for chipotle mayo.
Marinate the chicken thighs (any protein works).
Make a quick pineapple salsa; make sure it has enough lime and salt.
Sear the chicken in a little oil over medium-high heat until charred in spots, then assemble in tortillas.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe is on the creator's website (link in bio). Meal-prep friendly or good for a crowd. Recipe from Zachary Neman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Chicken Tacos
steps: Blend all the marinade ingredients until combined.
Pour over the chicken and marinate; longer is better.
Cook in a grill pan over medium-high heat about 4-5 minutes per side.
Chop the chicken into cubes and serve in corn tortillas with grilled onion, salsa roja, guacamole and pickled red onions.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe at freddsters.com. Recipe from @freddsters on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Crispy Chicken Sandwich
steps: Dredge the chicken breast in flour, egg, then corn flakes.
Air fry at 385F for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until it reaches 165F inside.
For the sauce, add the oil, lime juice, honey, cumin, salt, pepper, garlic and water to a pan and reduce a little over medium heat, then add the cilantro.
Slice the cucumber, cabbage and jalapeno, add honey, pickle juice, salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder and lime zest, and shake.
Assemble the chicken, sauce and salad on ciabatta.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Whole sandwich is about 475 calories and 45 g protein. Chicken quantity not given. Recipe from Donaldo Estevam on Instagram.

recipes.title: Coconut Curry Baked Dumplings
steps: Whisk coconut milk, red curry paste, garlic, soy sauce and cilantro in a baking dish.
Add frozen dumplings.
Bake uncovered at 400F for 20 minutes.
Top with green onion, chili crunch and sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: Recipe credited to @healthygirlkitchen; posted by @4480408607 (Elena).

recipes.title: Copycat Chick-fil-A Nuggets
steps: Cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces about 1 inch square.
Marinate in pickle juice for at least 30 minutes, longer if you have time.
Make the egg wash from milk and egg, and the flour mixture from flour, salt, paprika, black pepper and sugar.
Drain the chicken from the pickle juice, soak in the milk and egg wash, then toss gently in the flour.
Fry in peanut oil at 350F for 5 to 7 minutes.
Drain on paper towel for a few minutes before serving.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are in the full recipe sent by DM. Restaurants use a pressure fryer; this is a home pan-fry version. Recipe from Drew Reilly on Instagram.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chickpeas
steps: Heat 1-2 tbsp oil in a medium frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion and cherry tomatoes until softened.
Add the garlic, sundried tomatoes and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with the water to make a slurry.
Add the chickpeas, stock and slurry and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in the Parmesan, cream cheese and lemon. Season to taste.
recipes.notes: Contains Parmesan and cream cheese. Newt skips cheese, so omit or use a non-dairy cream substitute. Recipe from @carolehector on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Shawarma
steps: Combine lemon juice, olive oil, yogurt, pepper paste, garlic and spices; marinate chicken.
Thread chicken onto bamboo skewers and bake covered about 30 minutes; broil or blowtorch for smoky flavor.
Slice thin and return to the chicken juices.
Mix toum and mayo for garlic sauce.
Mix vegetable oil, pomegranate molasses, za'atar, salt and pepper paste for the crispy coating.
Layer chicken, sauce and pickles on pita; toast in a pan on medium heat, letting some oil drip underneath for a fried effect; wrap.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts spoken; full recipe on her site "Nutrient Matters" (search "crispy shawarma"). Recipe from @263786270 (Sara, Nutrient Matters) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Cilantro Lime Chicken Sandwich
steps: Dredge the chicken in flour, egg, then crushed corn flakes.
Air fry at 285F for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until 165F inside.
Simmer the sauce ingredients in a pan over medium heat until reduced a little; add cilantro.
Shake the salad ingredients together.
Build the sandwich on ciabatta with the sauce and serve with the salad.
recipes.notes: Macros from creator: chicken 184 cal/40g protein, sauce 120 cal, ciabatta 115 cal/5g protein. Recipe from Donaldo Estevam on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Honey Garlic Salmon Bites
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic herb Old Bay seasoning
steps: Cube the salmon and toss in a bowl with the olive oil and Old Bay.
Put the panko in a bowl and the paprika on a small plate.
Toss the salmon in the breadcrumbs, then gently coat in paprika for color.
Spray with olive oil spray.
Air fry at 380F for 8 minutes or until crisp.
Drizzle with honey and toss.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Sheila Williams on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Pan-Fried Shanghai Dumplings (Shengjian Bao)
ingredients: bunch of spring onions, finely chopped
1/4 Chinese cabbage, finely chopped and salted to remove water
black vinegar and chilli oil, to serve
steps: Mix the dry dough ingredients, slowly add the water while mixing, then knead 5-10 minutes. Rest and proof for 1 hour.
Combine the filling meat and all the seasoning, stirring in the same direction until the texture changes. Fold in the salted cabbage and optional stock jelly.
Deflate the dough and knead again 5-10 minutes until smooth. Divide into equal pieces and roll each out.
Fill and seal; pleating does not matter as they cook seam-side down.
Crisp the bottoms in oil over medium-high heat, add a generous splash of water, cover, reduce to medium and steam about 6-7 minutes until the water has evaporated.
Sprinkle with spring onions and sesame seeds, turn over, and serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.
recipes.notes: Half-yeasted dough does not fully double. Uses pork in the filling; try chicken or turkey mince instead. Recipe from Olive Magazine on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Rice Sushi Salad with Salmon and Spicy Mayo Dressing
steps: Whisk the dressing ingredients together.
Toss the rice with oil and soy sauce on a sheet pan, add the salmon, brush with some of the dressing, and bake until the rice is crisp and the salmon is cooked.
Toss carrots, cucumber, avocado, flaked salmon, seaweed, cilantro and rice with the dressing. Top with sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts, temperature or bake time given; full printable recipe via DM or link in her bio. Recipe from @6977693199 (Kristi Roeder) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Easy Loaf Pan Chicken
ingredients: 2.5 lb boneless chicken thighs (trim excess fat if you like)
1 medium yellow onion, processed in a food processor
1 tbsp urfa pepper (or Aleppo or other chili flakes)
steps: Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl.
Process the onion in a food processor and add to the chicken, then add the lemon juice, tomato paste and yogurt.
Add the salt, pepper, thyme, garlic powder and urfa pepper and mix well.
Marinate 2-6 hours, ideally overnight (or cook right away).
Preheat the oven to 425F. Let the chicken come to room temperature (about 30 minutes), then pack tightly into an 8.5x4.5x2.5 inch loaf pan.
Bake 50 minutes.
Tilt the pan into a glass jar to drain the juices, pour them back over the chicken, and repeat. Save the juices for soups.
Flip onto a cutting board and slice into thin slices or strips. Serve in bowls or with rice.
recipes.notes: Great for weekly meal prep; creator served it with low-carb rice. Recipe from Arash Hashemi on Instagram (@shredhappens).

recipes.title: Eggplant Fatteh (Lebanese)
steps: Toss the eggplant in a starch mixture and fry until crisp and golden; season with sumac.
Cook chopped onions and garlic in a little oil, add peeled tomatoes, cumin, salt, pepper and pepper paste.
Whisk the yogurt with tahini, garlic paste and salt.
Fry pita into chips and salt them.
Layer pita chips, tomato sauce, eggplant and yogurt sauce on a plate.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; the transcript degrades at the end. Recipe from Chef P on Instagram.

recipes.title: Egyptian Kofta & Potatoes (Kofta wa Batatas)
steps: Mix the ground beef with the blended peppers, onions, parsley and all the spices and salt.
Shape into small patties and layer with sliced potatoes and tomatoes in an oven-safe tray.
Mix the tomato paste, bouillon, hot water, pepper and 7 spice and pour over the tray.
Cover and bake at 400F until the kofta is mostly cooked and the potatoes are still slightly firm.
Cool, wrap well and freeze.
To serve, thaw overnight and bake covered at 400F for 30-40 minutes until potatoes are tender, or bake from frozen with extra time.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Contains beef; substitute ground chicken or lamb to fit his diet. Quantities for potatoes, tomatoes and tray size not given. Recipe from Ilene Nasseri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Extra-Crispy Korean Fried Chicken (Yangnyeom)
steps: Cut the chicken thighs and brine overnight in buttermilk and salt.
Mix the batter with some brine, flour, potato starch, vodka, wheat fiber, baking powder, baking soda and bouillon.
Mix the dredge from the dry batter ingredients plus garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika and pepper.
Dip chicken in batter, shake over the dredge so craggly bits form, press, then refrigerate 15 minutes.
Warm the sauce ingredients together.
Fry at 325 F, then fry again at 375 F.
Brush with sauce; it stays crisp for an hour or more, per the creator.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities were stated. The creator says wheat fiber is the key to staying crunchy under sauce. Recipe from @Charles (Chan Woo) Kim on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fattet Musakhan (Palestinian Chicken and Bread)
ingredients: pine nuts, toasted in hot ghee
steps: Cut the pita into pieces on a tray, drizzle with olive oil and salt, and bake until crisp.
Dice the onions and cook in olive oil over medium heat until soft.
Add the shredded chicken, salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, stock powder and the sumac.
Finish the chicken with pomegranate molasses and a squeeze of lemon.
Mix the yogurt, tahini, garlic, ground chili, salt and lemon into a sauce.
Layer bread on a plate, then the chicken, then the sauce (repeat for more layers).
Top with pine nuts and hot ghee, parsley and pomegranate seeds.
recipes.notes: Chicken was boiled with whole spices. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fire Roasted Tomato Lentils with Za'atar Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) diced fire roasted tomatoes
4 cups unsalted chicken bone broth (or veggie stock or water)
1 can (15 oz) beans of your choice, rinsed
½ tbsp flaky salt (or ½ tsp kosher)
steps: Method not given in the caption or audio; the creator's full written recipe is at the link in her bio.
Serve the lentils topped with the za'atar pine nuts and fresh mint.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Ingredients only; no cooking steps available. Recipe from Mishka Murphy on Instagram.

recipes.title: Gizh (Yemeni Tuna and Tamarind Sauce)
ingredients: 1 tbsp cumin seeds, toasted and ground
50 g tamarind paste, soaked in 3/4 cup hot water and strained
steps: Sweat the onions in a hot dry pan until golden, then add the ghee.
Add the tomato paste, mix well and cook 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes, season with salt and cook until soft.
Add the garlic, chilli and cumin, mix, then add the tamarind and cook 2 minutes.
Add the cilantro, tuna and water and cook about a minute.
Pour in the beaten egg and cook until set, then turn off the heat and adjust the salt.
recipes.notes: Traditionally made with dried anchovies. Serve with khobz, rice or aseed. Recipe from @akramsaid on Instagram.

recipes.title: Goat Kabsa (Kabsa Ilham)
ingredients: 3 tbsp tomato pepper paste (or tomato paste)
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot and fry the onions on medium-low until deep golden, about 20 minutes, stirring often.
Add cinnamon, cardamom and peppercorns; saute 1-2 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and fry briefly.
Add garlic and goat meat. Mix in kabsa spice, bouillon, black pepper, salt and pomegranate molasses; saute 2-3 minutes.
Pour in blended tomatoes and water. Cover and cook 1.5-2 hours until the meat is tender.
Add the rinsed rice and extra water if needed; cook until fluffy.
Serve hot.
recipes.notes: Traditional kabsa uses chicken quarters; substitute chicken for goat. Kabsa spice mix and pomegranate molasses are at halal stores. Recipe from @46675121700 (Muna) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Gochujang & Coconut Chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken with paprika, MSG, ginger powder, gochugaru and a little oil while you prep the onion and garlic.
Heat oil in a shallow pan on medium and fry the chicken skin side down until the skin is crispy. Flip and cook a few more minutes; it need not be cooked through.
Remove the chicken but keep the juices. Add onion, tomato paste and gochujang and cook 5 minutes until jammy. Add garlic and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour in the whole tin of coconut milk, add the lime leaf and bring to a simmer. Return the chicken and cook about 10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with rice, lime and coriander.
recipes.notes: Weeknight meals episode 17. Recipe from @56534335328 (Bella | Cooking Made Easy) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken & Rice Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
steps: Preheat the oven to 400F.
In a 9x13 baking dish combine uncooked rice, chicken, red onion, cherry tomatoes, garlic, lemon zest, olive oil and the seasoning blend.
Pour in 2 cups chicken broth and the juice of half the lemon; mix well and spread evenly with the rice mostly submerged.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 45-50 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165F.
Remove foil, add baby spinach and mix while hot so it wilts.
Top with crumbled feta, parsley and the juice of the remaining half lemon. Divide into 6 servings.
recipes.notes: Per serving: 402 calories, 40g protein, 9g fat, 39g carbs. Contains feta (omit or substitute). In the video he uses about 3 oz of the feta. Recipe from Adam Wolfe | Fitness on Instagram.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Fried Chicken
steps: Mix the chicken with Greek yogurt, then add the turmeric, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, pepper and salt and mix well.
Mix in a whole egg and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Dip the chicken in the flour mixture and set on a clean plate.
Fry in hot oil, flipping once, until golden brown.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Flour mixture composition and other amounts are not stated. Recipe from @theshabakitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Healthy Air Fryer Popcorn Chicken
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and seasonings in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix the diced chicken with the egg whites, then coat in the flour mix.
Air fry at 200C for 12-14 minutes.
recipes.notes: Whole batch is 419 calories and 68 g protein per the creator. Recipe from @seancaseyfit on Instagram.

recipes.title: Hijazi Muqalqal (Saudi Lamb with Tomatoes and Cumin)
ingredients: lamb fat or a little oil
steps: Dice the onion, garlic, chilies and tomatoes.
Render a little lamb fat in a pan (or use a tiny drizzle of oil) and cook the onion until it wilts.
Add the lamb and sear on high until it takes some color.
Add the garlic, chilies, tomatoes, salt, pepper, garlic powder and cumin and let them sizzle on high for a couple of minutes.
If the pan is dry add a splash of water, cover, and cook on low for 30 minutes until the sauce is thick and the meat very tender.
Garnish with fresh chili, squeeze lemon over and serve with bread or rice.
recipes.notes: Traditionally an Eid dish. Cumin is the key flavor. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Hoisin Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 14 oz dried wheat or egg noodles
6 scallions, white and green parts separated and sliced
steps: Cook noodles in salted boiling water until al dente; drain and rinse to cool.
Mix hoisin, soy sauce, sesame oil and maple syrup in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a large skillet; cook garlic and white scallion parts until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce quickly, add noodles and toss to coat.
Let noodles cook undisturbed 2-3 minutes until the bottom is crispy; season to taste.
Serve topped with sesame seeds and green scallion parts.
recipes.notes: Original by Hetty McKinnon for NYT Cooking. Recipe from @8277938889 (Ryan Miller) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Sushi Rolls (California and Shrimp Veggie)
ingredients: 12-15 pieces cooked shrimp, slit on the underside to lie flat
soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger for serving
steps: Cook the rice per package instructions and let sit 10-15 minutes.
Stir vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved, fold into the warm rice, and keep in the fridge until needed.
Mix the crab, mayo, sriracha and rice vinegar.
Spread rice thinly with a spatula on the rough side of the nori, covering about 2/3 of the sheet, and put filling in the center.
California roll: crab mix, cucumber, avocado. Shrimp veggie roll: shrimp, cucumber, grated carrot.
Roll tightly with the nori top lined up with the mat top, open the mat, continue rolling, and seal the end with a bit of warm water.
Slice and serve with soy sauce, wasabi and ginger.
recipes.notes: Supplies: bamboo mats, chopsticks, bowl of warm water to dip hands. Other fillings: sashimi-grade salmon or tuna, cooked or canned salmon, purple cabbage veggie roll. Makes 6 rolls. Recipe from @5570308508 (Jules) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ilham's Kabsa
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, skinless, cut into pieces
steps: Brown the onions in a drizzle of olive oil on high for 7-10 minutes until dark caramelized.
Add the chicken pieces with cinnamon, bay leaves, lumi and cardamom, stirring between additions.
Add the kabsa seasoning, pomegranate molasses, tomato puree and soy sauce and stir on high for 2-3 minutes.
Add the blended tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the water, garlic and stock cube, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Wash the basmati and add it so the water is 2-3 cm above the rice (more for a saucier kabsa).
Boil uncovered for 6-7 minutes, then drop to a simmer, cover and cook 20 minutes.
Serve on a platter with lime, chili and hot sauce.
recipes.notes: Ready in 45-50 minutes. Some sauce left at the edges is normal. The original uses short-grain rice; he prefers basmati. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken with salt, turmeric, pepper, coriander powder, chili powder, garam masala, ginger, garlic and sunflower oil for at least 1 hour, ideally 4.
Chop coriander, mint, chilies and onions.
Heat sunflower oil in the Instant Pot on saute for 2 minutes, add whole garam masala and the chopped vegetables; saute 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, 4 cups water and 6 cups washed rice; stir to combine. Add a generous spoonful of salt, kewra water and rose water.
Pressure cook for 6 minutes. Serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Indian cooking is eyeballed; amounts of spices not stated. About 30 min plus marinating. Recipe from @53065957745 (Sai Balaji) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Joojeh Kabab (Persian Saffron Chicken Kebab)
ingredients: saffron lemon butter sauce, for brushing
steps: Grind saffron with sugar and dissolve in hot water to make saffron water.
Cut chicken thighs into strips and marinate in a little saffron water for about 15 minutes.
Add lemon juice, yogurt, olive oil, black pepper, salt, turmeric, onions, garlic and a little saffron powder.
Refrigerate at least 3 to 4 hours.
Grill the chicken, brushing with saffron lemon butter.
Top with more sumac and saffron lemon butter; serve with sumac aioli, tahdig, shirazi salad and grilled vegetables.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given in the reel; full recipe is on her website (link in her bio). Recipe from @nutrientmatters on Instagram (Sara, Nutrient Matters).

recipes.title: Juicy Pan-Steamed Chicken Breast
steps: Season the chicken well.
Heat a little olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes without moving it.
Flip, add about 1 cup of water and cover.
Keep the heat on 2 minutes (4 for a thin pan or large chicken; cast iron 2-3), then turn the heat off.
Leave covered and untouched for 15 minutes.
Rest a few minutes, then slice or use.
recipes.notes: Set timers and don't peek. Recipe from smalltowninfluencer on Instagram.

recipes.title: Kashmiri Mutton Yakhni
ingredients: 2 tbsp dried mint (1 tbsp now, 1 tbsp later)
steps: Boil the lamb with the whole spices, garlic, ginger paste and 1 tbsp dried mint in 4 cups water for about an hour until tender.
Slice the onions and fry in ghee until brown; blend into a paste.
Wash the rice and boil in heavily salted water 12-15 minutes until fluffy; drain.
Strain the lamb and set aside, keeping the stock.
Whisk the yogurt and egg in the same pot until it boils; add 1 tbsp cornstarch if it splits.
Return the lamb with some stock, 1 tbsp onion paste (more to taste), salt and the remaining mint.
Simmer on low about 10 minutes until thick and coating the meat; serve with the rice.
recipes.notes: Creator compares it to Syrian shakriyeh. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Khao Soi (Thai Coconut Curry Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 2 oz dried guajillo chilies, soaked 30 min
16 oz fresh egg or wonton noodles
steps: Deseed and stem the chilies and soak in boiling hot water about 30 minutes.
Toast the coriander and black cardamom seeds (husk removed) until fragrant. Char shallots and ginger hard in a hot pan.
Blend chilies, aromatics, garlic, turmeric and salt into a smooth paste, adding water only if needed.
Heat oil and fry half the paste until it deepens in color. Pour in coconut milk and stock; season with dark soy, soy sauce and brown sugar and bring to a boil.
Add chicken leg quarters, reduce to a simmer, and cook 40-50 minutes until tender. Finish with fish sauce and lime juice.
Boil the noodles. Fry a small handful in oil heated to about 350F until crispy.
Build bowls: noodles, broth with a chicken piece, then crispy noodles, cilantro, green onion, mustard greens, peanuts and lime.
recipes.notes: Creator also sears chicken, peels skin and air fries it for crispy chicken skin. Paste can be bought at Asian grocers. Recipe from @41156334 (TheFarahKitchen) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Khoresht-e Fesenjan (Persian Pomegranate Walnut Stew with Duck)
ingredients: 2 duck leg quarters (or chicken leg quarters)
steps: Fry onion, walnuts and turmeric until nutty; add dates, pepper and pomegranate molasses and simmer with water.
Brown the duck legs until golden, then add to the stew with the cinnamon stick and simmer until pull-apart tender.
Wash basmati well, boil briefly, then strain. Grind saffron and bloom in warm water.
Cook rice with duck fat and saffron until a crust (tahdig) forms.
Serve stew over rice, garnished with pomegranate seeds.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Chicken is the common protein. Amounts for rice and duck fat not given; stew timing not stated. Recipe from @32489887640 (Zachary Neman) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Korean Popcorn Chicken
ingredients: 2 lb chicken breast (or thighs), cut into bite-size pieces
steps: In a large bowl combine the chicken, eggs, soy sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder and ginger powder. Mix until fully coated.
Add the cornstarch, flour and baking powder and toss until evenly coated.
Air fryer: preheat to 400F, cook 8 minutes, flip, and cook another 4 minutes until crispy. Oven: bake at 425F for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway.

In a pan over medium heat combine the gochujang, brown sugar, ketchup, honey, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil. Simmer 3-4 minutes until thick, turn off the heat and whisk in the butter.
Put the crispy chicken in a bowl, pour in about ½ cup of the sauce and toss to coat, adding more sauce if you like.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: Caption text is cut off after step 5, but the rest is garnish. Recipe from Jeremy | Family Food Vlogs on Instagram.

recipes.title: Kuku wa Kupaka (Mombasa Coconut Chicken)
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, skin on or off
water, enough to cover the chicken
steps: Brine the chicken in salt, lime and water.
Cook the onions until soft; shape does not matter because the sauce is blended.
Saute the garlic, ginger, chili, tomato and spices, add the coconut milk and blend until smooth.
Add the chicken to the sauce and slowly poach until just cooked through.
Lightly oil the chicken and grill until charred.
Return the chicken to the coconut sauce to soak up the flavor.
Serve with rice or mkate wa ufuta (sesame bread).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Poaching in the coconut sauce is what keeps the chicken juicy. Simba mbili is a Kenyan spice mix. Brine amounts and cook times not given. Recipe from Vanessa Loy-Mehri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lamb Seekh Kebabs
ingredients: Ground lamb (beef or chicken also work)
steps: Grind the tomato, onion and chillies together, then squeeze out all the liquid.
Mix the squeezed mixture into the lamb with the garlic, ginger, olive oil, lemon juice and seasoning.
Shape onto skewers and cook under a hot grill (or on a grill pan, in the oven or in an air fryer).
Brush generously with butter halfway through and at the end.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Quantities are on the creator's website, ashbaber.com. Notes: the creator says beef or chicken also work. Recipe from ash on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lazy Baked Meat with Tomatoes and Onions (Siniyet Lahme bi Banadoura w Basal)
ingredients: meat (type not stated; traditionally ground meat)
steps: Chop the tomatoes and onion and spread them with the meat in one baking pan.
Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and seven spice.
Top with oil or butter and add a little water.
Bake at 450F for about an hour, until the meat is tender.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts or meat type were stated; dish is traditionally made with beef or lamb, so choose lamb or chicken to avoid beef. Leftovers are good in a sandwich with hummus. Recipe from @amani.badran (Amani Badran) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lebanese Chicken Stew (Moghrabieh)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thighs, skin and bone on
2 tsp ground caraway, plus a pinch for serving
small handful finely chopped coriander leaves
steps: Heat the oil in a large casserole over medium heat. Put the chicken in skin side down with the shallots and cook 8-10 minutes, browning the skin and turning the shallots until golden.

Turn the chicken, add the garlic and cook a couple of minutes. Add the caraway, cumin, 7 spice and cinnamon, pour over the stock and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce to low and cook 40-45 minutes until the chicken is tender.

Meanwhile parboil the moghrabieh for 15 minutes and drain. Add it to the pan with the chickpeas, cover and cook 15 minutes. Uncover, raise the heat slightly and cook, shaking occasionally, 10-12 minutes until the sauce is thick.
Squeeze in the lemon, season with salt, and serve with coriander and lemon zest.
recipes.notes: Serves 4-6. From the cookbook Saffron in the Souks. Recipe from @johngregorysmith on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lebanese Mansaf
steps: Sear the salted lamb shanks in a pot, then add 1 onion, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, cloves, cardamom, peppercorns and the water. Cook about 2 hours (at least 1.5) until very tender.
Strain the stock and broil the shanks in the oven for color.
Wash the rice and soak for 30 minutes.
Saute a diced onion with the mince in a little ghee, add the rice, salt, pepper, seven spice and ground cinnamon.
Add about 3 cups of the stock (about 1 cm above the rice), bring to a boil, then simmer covered 20 minutes.
Toast the flour, stir in 1 tbsp ghee, then gradually whisk in stock until smooth and creamy for the sauce; season with salt.
Plate the rice, top with the shanks and pine nuts toasted in ghee, and serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken with Lemon Sauce
ingredients: 2 tbsp flour (oat flour works, or any flour)
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half lengthwise.
Marinate in the lemon juice and spices for 15-20 minutes.
Pan-fry or grill on medium-high heat 2-3 minutes per side until cooked through; set aside.
In the same pan, whisk the olive oil and flour into a paste, then add the water and lemon juice.
Keep whisking until the sauce thickens, pour over the chicken and garnish with parsley.
recipes.notes: No butter or cream. Caption is bilingual English/Arabic. Recipe from Samara Alkhammach on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Sandwich with Cucumber Cabbage Salad
ingredients: chicken (cooked; method and amount not shown)
steps: Blend chipotle peppers with mayo until smooth.
Combine lemon, soy sauce, garlic, butter, avocado oil, pepper and honey in a pan; cook, stirring, until reduced and thickened.
Shake cucumber, cabbage, avocado oil, lemon, salt, pepper, garlic powder and parsley in a container.
Assemble the cooked chicken sandwich with the sauces and serve with the salad.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Sponsored by Chosen Foods. Chicken prep and amounts not given. Recipe from Donaldo Estevam on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lentils with Garlic-Chili Dagga and Tahini (Damset Adas)
ingredients: 4 tbsp tahini (3 in the pot, rest to drizzle)
steps: Boil the lentils in 4 cups of water for 30-40 minutes with salt, pepper and cumin. If it thickens before the lentils are soft, add another cup of water.
Make the dagga: mash the garlic and chilis with a pinch of salt, then add the lemon juice.
When the lentils reach the consistency you like, stir in the dagga with 3 tbsp tahini and the olive oil and mix thoroughly.
Let cool a few minutes. Serve with a drizzle of tahini and olive oil and chopped tomato on top, with bread.
recipes.notes: Add the dagga later for a stronger garlic flavor, earlier for milder. Recipe shared by Eman. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Levantine Chicken Wings Marinade
steps: Clean and cut the wings.
Mix all marinade ingredients and coat the wings.
Marinate overnight, or at least a few hours.
Spread in a baking tray and bake at 200C (392F) on the middle rack until golden and cooked through, pouring extra marinade over if you like.
recipes.notes: Amounts are for 1 kg; the video used 2 kg. The video says to add the honey generously. Bake time not stated. Recipe from Nour Ghazall on Instagram.

recipes.title: Loaf Pan Chicken Shawarma
steps: Mix the marinade ingredients with the chicken and marinate at least 1 hour.
Transfer to a loaf pan.
Bake at 400F for about 45 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165F.
Let cool slightly and slice.
recipes.notes: Serve in a sandwich, salad or on its own. Recipe from @feelgoodfoodie on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mahmoos Gutaifi (Saudi Caramelized Onion Chicken and Rice)
ingredients: 5 onions (mix of red and white), very finely chopped
steps: Fry the finely chopped onions in oil on high for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring.
When they brown, drop the heat to the lowest and keep stirring until dark chocolate brown.
Add the chicken, give it a quick sear, then add the aromatics, garlic heads, spices and 5 cups of water. Cover and cook on medium about 30 minutes.
Move the chicken to a baking tray and broil until crisp.
Wash and soak the rice 30 minutes, add to the broth and adjust salt; water should be a fingertip above the rice. Add chilies on top.
Boil uncovered about 10 minutes until the water drops, then cover and cook on the lowest heat 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and keep the lid shut 20 more minutes.
Flip onto a serving plate, top with the garlic heads and chicken, and serve with lime and tahini sauce.
recipes.notes: Serves 5 to 6. Spice list can be flexible, per the creator. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa (Mohammed Moosa) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Malai Kofta
ingredients: whole spices incl. a cinnamon stick
steps: Mix grated boiled potato and paneer with cornstarch, spices and a little water; roll into balls and fry until golden.
Toast whole spices in oil, add onions, cashews, green chilies, tomato paste, chili, turmeric and coriander; cook a few minutes.
Remove the cinnamon stick and blend to a paste.
In more oil toast cumin, add ginger garlic paste, then the blended paste.
Finish with garam masala, cream, water to adjust, salt, sugar and kasuri methi.
Add the koftas to the sauce and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe by DM or the creator's website. Contains paneer (a cheese); Newt avoids cheese. Recipe from Vimarsh Patel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Marag Simach (Kuwaiti Fish Stew)
ingredients: a little butter for the rice (optional)
steps: Season the fish with a teaspoon of each spice, then shallow fry in a little oil until golden, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauté the onion in the same pot until wilted, then add garlic, half the dill, the coriander, ginger paste and tomato paste. Stir on high until the paste changes color.
Add the blended tomatoes, salt, pepper, half a teaspoon of the fish seasonings, sugar and whole aromatics. Cook on medium until thickened, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Nestle the fish into the sauce without stirring, scatter the remaining dill on top, and simmer on low about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and soak the rice, then boil in plenty of water (about 1 L per cup of rice) with salt, aromatics and stock powder for 6 to 7 minutes.
Strain the rice, return to the pot and let it steam for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew over the rice.
recipes.notes: Use any fish steaks. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa (Mohammed Moosa) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mbakbaka (Libyan Pasta with Meat and Tomato)
steps: Fry the onion in olive oil, then add the meat with the spices and tomato paste.
Once aromatic, add the blended tomatoes and 1 cup water and simmer on medium about 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
Add the pasta with 2 cups water and cook until done, adding water if too thick.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of basil.
recipes.notes: Meat is the cook's choice; the video mentions lamb or beef, so use lamb, chicken or another meat to avoid beef. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa (Mohammed Moosa) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mbassata (M'bassata) Palestinian Chicken and Rice
steps: Fry the chicken with the onion and whole spices (cinnamon, bay, cardamom).
Add 5 cups water and boil until very tender, about 45 minutes.
Wash the rice and soak it.
Remove the chicken to a tray, brush with a mix of spices (paprika, seven spice) and olive oil, and bake until golden and crisp.
Season the stock with salt, pepper and 3 tbsp tomato paste, add the rice; liquid should sit 3-4 cm above the rice.
Boil 5 minutes, then reduce to a simmer, cover and cook 12-15 minutes.
Chop the garlic and fry in ghee until blonde.
Turn the rice onto a plate, top with the chicken and drizzle with the garlic ghee.
recipes.notes: Creator uses Canary basmati. Total liquid is 7 cups with 5 used for the chicken, which then tops up the stock. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mbatten (Libyan Stuffed Potatoes)
steps: Saute the onion and garlic in oil over medium heat, add the mince and spices, then the tomato puree.
Mix the cooked meat with the parsley, chilli, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Peel and slice the potatoes into wedges and hollow them to fill with the meat mixture.
Dip the filled potatoes in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumb and flour mixture.
Fry until crisp and golden and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Use lamb mince to avoid beef. Hollowing/slicing detail is shown on screen. Recipe from @danbui on Instagram.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Baked Chicken
steps: Add everything except the chicken to a food processor and pulse until smooth.
Coat the chicken in the marinade (can be prepped in advance).
Preheat the oven to 425F. Place the chicken in a baking dish and cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake 15 more minutes until golden brown and crisp.
recipes.notes: Serve with vermicelli rice and Egyptian tomato and cucumber salad (both on the creators' blog). Recipe from Alia & Radwa Elkaffas on Instagram.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Chuck Roast
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F and grab an oven-safe dish with a lid.
Pat the roast dry, season both sides with salt and pepper, then rub in the spices.
Add garlic cloves, bone broth and the cinnamon stick to the dish.
Cover and bake 1 hour per pound plus an extra hour (3.5 hours for 2.5 lb).
Shred the beef with two forks and return to the oven 15-30 minutes at 400F.
Mix onion, parsley, sumac, salt and lemon juice and let sit 15-20 minutes.
Serve over dollops of yogurt or labneh with pickled onions, herbs and rice.
recipes.notes: Contains beef; for Newt, try lamb or chicken thighs instead (not tested). Recipe from @Arash Hashemi (Shred Happens) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Minced Chicken Kebabs with Persian Saffron Cranberry Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, finely minced
1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, finely minced
1 medium onion, finely chopped (excess water squeezed out)
10 saffron strands in 1/2 cup hot water
steps: Mix the chicken mince with the salt, pepper, garlic, parsley, onion, chilies, chili flakes and powder, garlic and onion powder, cumin and coriander for 8-10 minutes until sticky; make sure no excess water.
Refrigerate the kebab mixture 2 hours.
Shape long kebabs on skewers and grill or pan fry on medium 8-10 minutes, turning.
Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and soak 1 hour; bloom the saffron in hot water 20 minutes.
In a skillet saute the peppercorns, bay leaf, black cardamom and cloves in oil for 30 seconds, add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cook the rice 10-15 minutes until 3/4 done, then drain.
Add butter, cranberries and saffron water on top, lowest heat, covered, 20 minutes; turn off and rest 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, fluff and serve with the kebabs.
recipes.notes: Caption method mentions paprika that is not in the ingredient list. Recipe from Iram Mansoor on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mnazzala Hijazia (Hijazi Lamb in Tahini Sauce)
ingredients: salt, pepper and a pinch of cumin
steps: Saute the diced onion in a drizzle of olive oil until it wilts.
Add the lamb and season with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom and the minced garlic.
Sear on high until it takes some color, add 2 cups of water, cover and cook on medium about 40 minutes until fork tender.
Whisk the tahini, vinegar, salt, pepper, cumin and 1/2 cup water until creamy.
Add the sauce to the pan and stir gently; cover and cook on low a few minutes until bubbly.
Serve with bread or rice and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.notes: Traditionally eaten on the morning of Eid. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mosuli Qalia (Qalia Maslawiya)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut in large cubes
1/2 tsp black lumi (dried lime) powder, optional
steps: Render the lamb fat in a pot for 3-4 minutes over medium heat.
Add the lamb cubes and sear on high for about 5 minutes until browned.
Add the black pepper, lumi and date molasses and stir.
Add the whole onions, mix, and pour in boiling water to just cover everything.
Cook on medium heat for one hour, season with salt, cover and cook another 30 minutes until the water has evaporated and a thick sauce remains.
Pour onto a serving plate, squeeze lemon over, and serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Creator suggests using strong, freshly ground spices. Keep the lamb pieces large because they melt as they cook. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Muhammara Chickpea Skillet
ingredients: warm pita or naan, to serve
steps: Method is not given in the caption or audio; see the full recipe on Dishing Out Health (search "dishingouthealth chickpea skillet").
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Recipe from @dishingouthealth on Instagram.

recipes.title: Nardooni Chicken (Dijaj Nardooni)
ingredients: a few saffron threads, crushed and soaked in a splash of water
1 whole skinless chicken, cut into pieces
2-3 tbsp chopped dill and fenugreek herbs
2 cups pomegranate seeds (1 cup for the sauce, rest to garnish)
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and saffron water.
Sear in the oil for 6-7 minutes to hold shape and color it, then remove.
Cook the onion in the same pot until wilted.
Add garlic, tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, herbs and 1 cup pomegranate seeds and cook a few minutes on high.
Add the pomegranate juice and water, bring to a boil, return the chicken, cover and simmer at least an hour until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and serve with barberry rice.
recipes.notes: The sauce should thicken to coat the chicken. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Nepali-Style Chicken Chukauni
ingredients: 400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes
oil for frying, light brush or spray
1 cup thick curd or Greek yogurt
steps: Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, chili powder, turmeric and lemon juice; rest 10-15 minutes.
Pan-fry in very little oil on medium-high until golden; transfer to a bowl.
Add sliced onion, green chilies and half the coriander; mix and set aside.
Whisk curd with garlic paste, salt and sugar until smooth.
Heat mustard oil until smoking, turn off heat, add turmeric, chili powder and kasuri methi.
Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently.
Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture, mix gently and finish with remaining coriander.
Serve with rotis or rice.
recipes.notes: Serves 3; under 30 minutes. Recipe from @3155631723 (Aathira Sethumadhavan) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Omani One-Pot Pressure Cooker Ribs and Rice
steps: Use the pressure cooker's saute function to cook the onions, coriander and spices in olive oil, then add the tomato paste.
Add the ribs, garlic and spices, top with water and add a splash of vinegar.
Pressure cook the meat about 45 minutes.
Add the washed and soaked rice, mix well, and pressure cook again for about 9 minutes.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts for spices, water or rice; full recipe at swahilifood.com. Rib type not stated: check it, since ribs could be beef or pork, or use lamb. Recipe from Vanessa Loy-Mehri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Omani Qalia (Lamb Confit with Rice)
ingredients: salt to taste (added at the end)
steps: Put the lamb in a cold pot with the garlic and all the spices, without salt.
Turn the heat to high and stir for about 5 minutes until the meat releases its juices.
Cover, reduce to medium and cook about an hour, checking occasionally, until the juices evaporate and the meat fries and confits in its own fat.
Salt the lamb at the end.
Wash and soak the rice, then add to a pot with ghee, salt, stock powder, spices and 2 cups water; boil 6-7 minutes.
Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook 15 minutes.
Plate the rice, top with the lamb and drizzle with honey.
recipes.notes: Traditionally served at Eid, often with bread. Garlic is from the Arabic narration. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pan Chicken and Rice
steps: Season the chicken thighs generously and sear in oil about 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
To the pan add tomato paste, sundried tomatoes, chili flakes, shallot or onion, garlic and rice and toast the rice.
Cover with chicken broth, add the chicken back and cover until the rice is cooked.
Finish with Parmesan, a little cream, cilantro and basil.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Contains Parmesan; leave it out to avoid cheese. Recipe from @nickdigiovanni on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pan Chicken Shawarma with Roasted Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
fresh parsley and lemon slices, to garnish
steps: Pat the chicken dry, cut into large chunks, and toss in the marinade mixed from the yogurt, tomato paste, garlic, lemon juice and spices. Marinate as long as you can.
Preheat the oven to 425F (220C). Slice the top off a garlic head, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil and roast 45-60 minutes.
Spread the chicken on a large dish or sheet pan, nestle in the red onion, and drizzle with 4 tbsp olive oil.
Bake 30-40 minutes until browned, crisp at the edges and cooked through. Baste with the pan juices.
Squeeze the roasted garlic into a bowl, mash, and mix with the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, pepper and parsley; adjust to taste.
Serve on fluffy rice with chicken and onion, lemon, parsley and pan juices.
recipes.notes: Recommended plating over rice. Recipe from Ben Chelin on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pan Moroccan Chicken and Potato Bake
steps: Mix the olive oil, yogurt, spices, garlic, parsley and cilantro into a marinade.
Toss the drumsticks, potatoes and lemon wedges in the marinade and put in a pan.
Roast in the oven (temperature and time on the blog).
Add the olives and preserved lemons after it comes out and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts, oven temperature or time in the reel; full recipe at https://moribyan.com/one-pan-moroccan-chicken-bake/ . Recipe from @moribyan on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken Tikka Masala Rice
steps: Marinate the chicken thighs in spices, garlic, ginger and lemon juice (optional rest time).
Sear the chicken until about 70% done, then remove.
In the same pot cook onions with garlic, ginger, tomato paste and the spices.
Add the rice and coconut milk with liquid, nestle the chicken in, cover and cook about 25 minutes.
Toss cucumbers in green chutney thinned with olive oil and serve alongside.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts in the reel; full recipe at cheffinwithzach.com. Recipe from Zachary Neman on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pot Green Curry Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, soaked 30 minutes and rinsed
4 large carrots, cut into 1/2 inch rounds
florets from 1 large head of broccoli
steps: Heat the avocado oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken 3-5 minutes per side, then set aside.
Reduce to medium, add a drizzle of oil, onion, carrots and broccoli and cook about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook 1-2 minutes.
Make a well, add the curry paste and stir 30 seconds before mixing into the veg.
Add broth and coconut milk, scraping up stuck bits.
Add rinsed rice and about 1 tsp salt and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken, submerged halfway, cover, reduce to low and simmer 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest covered 10-15 minutes.
Serve with plenty of lime juice and cilantro.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @Olivia Adriance on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pot Nando's Chicken and Halloumi Bake
ingredients: 100 ml chicken gravy or chicken stock
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C.
Dice the chicken and marinate in a glass tub with half of the Nando's jar for about 30 minutes.
In glass ovenproof containers combine rice, marinated chicken, peppers, tomatoes, yogurt, remaining Nando's sauce and stock.
Bake 30-35 minutes or until the chicken is cooked; it looks liquidy but the rice absorbs it.
Air fry the halloumi while it bakes and add it on top.
recipes.notes: Cooled portions keep 3 days in fridge or 1 month frozen; reheat thoroughly. Halloumi is cheese: leave it off. Recipe from @nickigeorgiou on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Pot Shawarma Chicken with Yellow Rice
steps: Toss chicken thighs with shawarma seasoning, smoked paprika and lemon juice (marinate if time allows).
Sear the chicken until about 70% cooked, then remove.
Cook onion and garlic in the fond, add turmeric, then the rice and liquid.
Return the chicken, cover and cook as normal rice, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile make a vinegar slaw and a quick tahini sauce.
Fluff the rice, slice the chicken and serve with the toppings.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts not given; recipes at cheffinwithzach.com. Recipe from Zachary Neman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oven Lamb Mandi (Yemeni)
steps: Mix ghee, olive oil, saffron, salt and pepper and rub all over the lamb.
Put the aromatics and 5 cups boiling water in a baking tray, set a wire rack with the lamb on top, cover with a baking sheet and seal tightly with foil.
Bake at 220C for 20 minutes, then at 175-180C for 3 more hours.
Roughly blend the sahawuq ingredients so it stays chunky.
Wash the rice and soak in hot water 30 minutes.
Remove the rack and lamb; add the rice to the broth, with liquid about 1 cm above the rice; return the rack and lamb, cover tightly.
Bake at 220C 15 minutes, then 160C 30 minutes (about 45 total).
Optional: smoke with a piece of charcoal and drizzle of ghee for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb over the rice with sahawuq.
recipes.notes: Not traditional pit-cooked. Without a rack, wrap lamb in foil inside the tray. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oven Tray Kebab (Turkish Kofte-Style)
steps: Process the onion and parsley in a food processor and squeeze out the liquid.
Knead the ground meat with the onion, parsley and spices.
Spread the mixture on a parchment-lined tray and cut into long strips with gaps in between.
Arrange tomatoes and peppers along the edge, season with salt and olive oil.
Bake in a preheated oven at 220C (top and bottom heat) for 15 minutes.
Switch to the top grill and brown lightly without drying out.
If the vegetables are not browned enough, roast them on a separate tray.
recipes.notes: Caption is in Turkish and does not say which meat; use lamb or chicken to avoid beef. Recipe from @ayseseymabektas on Instagram (Ayşe Bektaş).

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Marinated Chicken and Potatoes (Frooj w Batata)
ingredients: optional vegetables: onion, peppers, tomato, mushrooms
steps: Mix the chicken marinade; add up to 1/4 cup water if too thick.
Score the chicken thighs and coat well so the marinade gets inside. Marinate 2 hours or overnight in the fridge.
Slice the potatoes to medium thickness and coat in the same marinade plus the extra spices.
Spread on a tray lined with parchment, adding vegetables if you like.
Cover with parchment, then foil, and bake until cooked (temperature and time are not stated).
Uncover to brown at the end, then toss immediately with garlic and lemon.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Measurements are translated from the Arabic caption (tbsp/tsp). Oven temperature and time are not given. Recipe from ᗩᒪI on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oven-Roasted Spiced Chicken with Rice
steps: Season the chicken with oil, salt, turmeric, paprika, black pepper, ginger, cinnamon and food coloring.
Cover with parchment and bake at 200C for about 1.5 hours.
Remove the parchment and brown the chicken on top.
Make the rice with the tomato, garlic, cilantro, lemon, oil, salt and whole spices, adding water.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; caption is in Arabic and the audio is sparse. Recipe from @abdullahalmatrood on Instagram.

recipes.title: Padakjeon (Korean Pan-Fried Chicken with Green Onion)
steps: Chop the chicken and marinate with 2 tbsp cooking wine, salt and pepper for 30 minutes.
Mix the chicken with the chilies, sliced garlic, fish sauce, potato starch and water into a batter.
Soak the sliced green onions in ice water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Combine the sauce ingredients.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, spoon in the batter and spread slightly, and fry 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked.
Layer the chicken, top with the green onions and drizzle with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Sponsored post (CHEFWIN stainless steel pan provided for review). Recipe from Hubbybap on Instagram.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer Rice
steps: Chop the onion, green chilies and paneer.
Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, run under cold water and squeeze out the excess.
Blend the spinach with green chilies, ginger garlic paste and a touch of water.
Heat oil in a pan, fry the paneer cubes and set aside.
In a large pot heat oil or ghee, add cumin seeds, then onions and cook until soft.
Add the spinach gravy, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala and salt and mix.
Add the leftover rice, toss in the paneer and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are not given; full recipe at amateurprochef.com or by DM. Recipe from Vimarsh Patel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Palestinian Musakhan
steps: Chop the onions and put them in a pan with the chicken. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, cardamom, cinnamon and sumac.
Pour in the olive oil until the contents are submerged.
Cook on high until it starts to boil, then cover and seal and cook about 1 hour.
