Place the bread on a baking tray, top with the onions and chicken, and bake until finished.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts of spices, oven temperature and time not given. The video is sarcastic commentary on Palestinian resilience. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Palestinian Okra Stew with Lamb (Bamya)
ingredients: 10 cloves garlic (plus extra for the finish)
steps: Salt the lamb and put in a pot with half the onion, bay leaves, peppercorns and 3 cups of water. Simmer 30 minutes.
Wash the rice and soak it 30 minutes.
Dice the other half of the onion and saute in a little olive oil; add the okra and cook until it takes on some color.
Blend the tomatoes, garlic and tomato puree.
When the lamb is almost soft, add the okra, tomato sauce and a little salt, and simmer 30 minutes.
Toast the vermicelli in a little olive oil until brown, add the rice and 3 cups water, bring to a boil, then simmer covered 20 minutes.
Fry minced garlic in olive oil until browned, add a big handful of chopped basil, and gently stir into the stew.
Serve the stew over the rice.
recipes.notes: Creator says other cuts of meat work; different regions use mint or coriander instead of basil. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Beef Kabobs (Suya / Sarri)
ingredients: 1 heaping tbsp creamy or crunchy peanut butter (one with some sugar, like Jif)
steps: Mix the marinade ingredients in a bowl with the beef.
Cover in an airtight container and refrigerate a few hours, preferably overnight.
Skewer and grill to your preferred doneness over hot coals; the edges will caramelize.
recipes.notes: Amounts are per pound of beef. Peanut butter tenderizes the meat. Recipe from @yaseenjawad on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peanut Chilli Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl combine garlic, peanut butter, chopped peanuts, tahini, tamari, chilli oil, lime juice, hot water and sesame seeds.
Whisk until the sauce is creamy and glossy; the hot water emulsifies the tahini and peanut butter.
Add the cooked noodles and most of the scallions and toss to coat.
Garnish with the remaining scallions and extra sesame seeds and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Creator says she developed it as a personal chef in the Middle East. Recipe from @453312266 (Claire Sharryn Roberto) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pesto and White Bean Protein Pizza (gluten-free)
steps: Mix gluten-free flour and Greek yogurt into a simple dough and shape the crust.
Top with white beans, garlic, spinach, kale and pesto.
Bake until the crust is set (time and temperature not given).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Part of a $60 weekly plan; amounts via DM. Jarred pesto often contains parmesan, so choose a dairy-free pesto to avoid cheese. Recipe from @Jenn Lueke on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pineapple Soy Steak Marinade
ingredients: Soy sauce, equal to the pineapple juice
steps: Combine pineapple juice, an equal amount of soy sauce and about a quarter can of water in a bag with the steak, enough to submerge it.
Marinate 15 to 20 minutes at most; longer breaks down the meat too much.
Cook the steak as you like.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Pineapple enzymes break down connective tissue, so don't exceed 20 minutes. Cooking method isn't shown. Contains beef as written; untested on other meats. Recipe from @Spencer on Instagram.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup (Shorbat Adas)
ingredients: 2 chicken bouillon cubes (if stock is salty)
steps: Saute the onion, potato and carrots in the olive oil with the cumin, paprika and salt until sweaty.
Add the red lentils and the chicken stock; add bouillon according to the saltiness of the stock.
Bring to a rigorous boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover and cook about 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Blend the soup and finish with a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.notes: Without stock use water and 3-4 more bouillon cubes. Recipe from @ahmadalzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Restaurant-Style Salmon with White Wine Butter Sauce
steps: Remove the thin belly and cook it separately. Check for pin bones and, if keeping the skin, scales. Portion the fillet.
Slice dill finely, mix with salt, and press the flesh side of the salmon into it.
Heat a pan on medium-low with a touch of oil. Salt the skin and place the salmon skin side down with light pressure. Cook 4 minutes, then flip.
Add a little butter and baste 2-3 minutes. Remove the crispy skin and set aside.
Sauce: in a little clarified butter, cook garlic, add white wine and reduce, add chicken stock and reduce again.
Add Dijon, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Lower the heat and work in cubes of unsalted butter. Finish with chives.
Serve over creamy mash with the crisp skin cut up on top and sauce spooned over.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities or exact heat given in the video. Recipe from Sonny Hurrell on Instagram.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Chana Masala
steps: Add everything to the rice cooker and mix.
Cook on the white or mixed setting.
Stir and serve.
recipes.notes: Makes about 5 servings per the creator. She mentions garlic in the video but it is not in the written list. Free rice cooker guide via DM. Recipe from serena yau on Instagram.

recipes.title: Rotisserie Chicken Pho
ingredients: rock sugar the size of a golf ball (or 1-2 tbsp regular sugar)
Pho spices (or use a premade bag)
thinly sliced purple or yellow onion
steps: Shred all the meat off the chicken and set aside.
Toast the spices in a dry skillet; char the onion and ginger over flame, in the oven or in an air fryer.
Add the carcass, onion, ginger, spices, water, rock sugar, fish sauce and salt to a large pot and bring to a boil, skimming off foam.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes, then remove the spice bag and adjust seasoning.
Cook a nest of noodles in boiling water 30 to 45 seconds per bowl, add to the bowl with the chicken, pour hot broth over.
Top with scallion, cilantro, onion, basil, sprouts, and add sriracha, hoisin and pepper as desired.
recipes.notes: Cook noodles per bowl; they do not keep. Recipe from @alissanguyenwon on Instagram (Alissa Nguyen Won).

recipes.title: Ruz Jirbi (Tunisian Herbed Chicken Rice)
ingredients: big handful of spinach or chard
caraway powder (the main traditional spice; amount not given)
steps: Dice the vegetables and herbs and add to a large bowl.
Add the chopped chicken and the rice.
Add salt, spices, harissa, tomato puree and olive oil and mix well to coat everything.
Steaming pot: steam the mixture covered about 45 minutes. Regular pot: add 4 cups water, cover, and cook on the lowest heat about 1 hour.
Serve on a plate topped with the chicken and garnish with olives.
recipes.notes: Creator forgot to mention the parsley and dried mint in the video (they are in the caption). Video also mentions chickpeas and peas, not listed in the caption. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa (Mohammed Moosa) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ruz Madini (Saudi Madini Rice with Lamb)
ingredients: 4 cups lamb stock (about 1 cm above the rice)
a handful of almonds, toasted in ghee
steps: Boil the lamb in 6 cups water with cardamom pods, bay leaves, peppercorns and about 4 mastic stones for 1.5 hours, until very tender.
Mix 1 cup stock with 1 tbsp ghee, tomato puree, saffron water, cumin, cinnamon, garlic, lemon juice, rose water and salt.
Lay the lamb on a baking tray, smother with the sauce and broil a few minutes until charred.
Wash the rice, add to 4 cups boiling stock (salted) so the liquid sits about 1 cm above the rice; add boiling water if needed. Boil on high until it absorbs most of the liquid and rises.
Melt 2 heaping tbsp ghee with 7-8 mastic stones and pour over the rice. Stir gently, cover, and cook on the lowest heat about 20 minutes.
Flip the rice onto a plate, top with the lamb, and garnish with soaked raisins and almonds toasted in ghee.
recipes.notes: Mastic (mistika) is a resin spice from Middle Eastern shops. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Saffron Chicken and Rice (Tahjeen)
ingredients: 1 tsp ground saffron (dissolved with an ice cube to make saffron water)
salt, plenty, for the boiling water
steps: Boil water with plenty of salt. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and parboil until half cooked, not hard but not soft. Drain and set aside.
Put an ice cube in a small bowl with ground saffron and let it melt to extract the flavor.
Season the cubed chicken with butter, salt, pepper, turmeric and some saffron water, then cook over medium heat with the minced garlic. Set aside.
Fry the barberries and pistachios over low heat with a little butter and the sugar.
Whisk the oil, egg yolks, yogurt and saffron water with a squeeze of lemon, and mix with the rice.
Butter a dish (clear glass lets you see the browning). Layer half the rice, then the chicken, then the barberries and pistachios, then the remaining rice. Cover with foil.
Bake at 160C for 50-60 minutes, checking until the rice browns.
Cool a little, flip onto a plate and serve with cucumber yogurt, topped with more barberries and pistachios.
recipes.notes: Translated from the Arabic caption. Recipe from @chefm on Instagram.

recipes.title: Salmon Sushi Bake
ingredients: salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, olive oil (to season)
steps: Season salmon with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika and a drizzle of olive oil. Bake at 200C (400F) for 20 min, or air-fry at 190C (375F) for 12-15 min. Remove skin and flake.
Mix flaked salmon, shredded imitation crab, softened cream cheese, Japanese mayo, sriracha and green onions.
Mix warm rice with rice vinegar, sugar, salt and sesame oil. Spread in a baking dish and sprinkle with furikake.
Top with the salmon mixture. Bake at 190C (380F) for 10 minutes, then broil 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Drizzle with sriracha and spicy mayo; top with green onions and black sesame seeds. Serve with roasted nori.
recipes.notes: Cream cheese is used in the mixture; omit or sub mayo/avocado to skip cheese. Inspired by @alissanguyen_. Recipe from @67101335752 (Hesti) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sea Bass with Beurre Monte
steps: Season the fish and sear in avocado oil with the garlic and rosemary until cooked; remove.
Add the water to the same pan and simmer.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the cold cubed butter a few cubes at a time until the sauce is creamy.
Spoon over the fish.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Fish cooking details are at kellyscleankitchen.com/2024/06/19/sea-bass-with-beurre-monte/. Works on any protein or vegetable. Recipe from Kelly Scott on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Kefta Wraps
ingredients: 1 large or 2 medium yellow onions, grated and squeezed dry
4 tbsp olive oil, for the top
steps: Preheat the oven to 400F (205C). Slice the tops off two garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil and roast 45-60 minutes until golden and soft.
Grate the onion and squeeze out all the liquid with paper towel or cheesecloth so the kefta isn't watery.
Combine the chicken, tomato paste, minced garlic, spices, parsley, cilantro and onion and mix by hand 2-3 minutes until sticky.
Spread onto a sheet pan about 1/2 inch (1.25 cm) thick, score into 1-inch strips and drizzle with 4 tbsp olive oil.
Bake 12-15 minutes, then broil 2-5 minutes until golden and slightly crisp.
Toss the salad ingredients together in a bowl.
Squeeze the roasted garlic into a bowl, mash, and mix with the mayo, yogurt, lemon juice, paprika and pepper until smooth.
Spread sauce on lavash or pita, add 1-2 strips of kefta and the salad, and roll tight. Optionally crisp in a lightly oiled skillet 1-2 minutes per side.
recipes.notes: Full recipe is also in the creator's free Osta Recipes app. Recipe from Ben Chelin on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Shawarma with Sumac Slaw and Tahini
steps: Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, shawarma seasoning and smoked paprika. Add the chicken thighs and onion and mix; let sit while you make the toppings.
Mix the slaw ingredients with sumac.
Make the tahini sauce with garlic, salt, lemon juice and tahini, slowly mixing in ice water to the consistency you like.
Spread the chicken on a sheet tray and cook at 500F about 70 percent of the way.
Slice the chicken and return to the oven under the broiler for color.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Sponsored by Pepsi. Recipe from @zachneman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Teriyaki Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 480g (2.5 cups) short grain or sushi rice, dry weight
steps: Add chicken thighs, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, mirin, ginger paste and garlic paste to the slow cooker.
Cook on high 4-5 hours or low 5+ hours until the chicken is cooked through.
Mix the cornstarch and cold water, stir into the sauce and let sit uncovered 15-20 minutes to thicken.
Cook the rice separately and mix it into the chicken (or keep separate).
Mix mayo, Greek yogurt, sriracha, salt, pepper and garlic powder, thinning with milk as needed.
Portion into 8 containers, top with green onions and yum yum sauce. Store frozen and reheat.
recipes.notes: Per serving: 515 cal, 40g protein, 65g carbs, 9g fat. Recipe from Tom Walsh on Instagram (Slow Cooker Meal Prep Cookbook).

recipes.title: Smashed Potatoes on Beetroot Beans
ingredients: dill oil or extra virgin olive oil
steps: Mix dried dill, thyme and flaky salt to make dill salt.
Peel beetroot, wrap in foil with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Put the beetroot and potatoes on a tray, coat potatoes with dill salt and olive oil, toss, roast at 400F (200C) for 35 minutes.
Smash the potatoes with a fork, drizzle with maple syrup, roast 15 more minutes until crisp.
Drain and rinse beans; blend with roasted beetroot, garlic, tahini, lemon, cumin and a little water or plant milk until smooth; adjust seasoning.
Dollop the beetroot beans on a platter, top with potatoes, finish with dill and oil.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @bosh.tv on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spanish Style Chicken Orzo
ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lb) boneless skinless chicken thighs
75 g (1/2 cup) sun-dried tomatoes, finely diced
steps: Whisk the chicken seasonings with the oil and lemon juice in a large bowl, toss in the chicken, cover and marinate in the fridge (even 20 minutes helps, up to overnight). Bring close to room temperature before frying.
Fry the chicken in a large deep pan over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes per side, until lightly charred and cooked through. Remove, leaving the oil.
Lower the heat to medium and fry the onion and pepper until soft/golden. Add the chorizo and garlic for 1-2 minutes, stir in the tomato puree for a minute, then the orzo.
Pour in the stock and add the olives, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and smoked paprika. Stir and bring to a simmer.

Reduce the heat slightly and let it bubble, stirring fairly regularly, until the sauce thickens and the orzo is al dente. Add more stock or boiling water a splash at a time if it dries out. Adjust seasoning.
Return the chicken with its resting juices to warm through and garnish with parsley.
recipes.notes: Spanish chorizo is pork; omit it or swap for a non-pork sausage. Use low-salt stock if sensitive to salt. Recipe from @chefchriscollins on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Eggplant with Pomegranate Molasses and Tahini
ingredients: extra tahini and pomegranate molasses, to drizzle
steps: Dice the eggplants into chunky cubes and sear in a drizzle of olive oil for about 5 minutes until toasty.
Push the eggplant aside, add the onion, a little garlic and the tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes soften.
Mix everything and season with salt, pepper, coriander, chili powder and sumac.
Stir in the pomegranate molasses and tahini and let it cook together a couple of minutes on low.
Garnish with extra tahini, pomegranate molasses and parsley and serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Caption amounts used; the video uses slightly different amounts (1 tbsp each of molasses and tahini, 2 tomatoes, 1/2 tsp chili). Serve with bread and pomegranate tea. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Pad See Ew (Stir-Fried Soy Sauce Noodles)
steps: Marinate the beef in the soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornstarch.
Combine the sauce ingredients.
Separate gai lan leaves from stems and slice the stems thinly.
In a hot oiled wok cook the beef to 80% done; set aside.
Add oil; cook garlic, chilies and gai lan stems 2 minutes on medium, add leaves until wilted. Scramble the eggs on the side and mix in; set aside.
Add more oil and the noodles, pour the sauce over and saute until absorbed.
Add the beef and broccoli mixture back and mix.
recipes.notes: Be generous with oil. Homemade noodles: water, rice flour, tapioca starch, salt; steam the batter 3 minutes per sheet (amounts on her Substack). Protein is beef as written. Recipe from @Elizabeth Wu Williams on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Broccoli Chicken Noodles
steps: Cube the chicken, sprinkle with baking soda, wait 15 minutes, then rinse and dry.
Slice the broccoli thinly.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok, seasoning with soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, white pepper and salt. Remove when golden.
Add oil and stir-fry the broccoli in the same pan.
Combine sauce ingredients and simmer on low while the egg noodles cook.
Toss noodles, chicken and broccoli in the sauce and top with green onions, peanuts and red pepper flakes.
recipes.notes: Serves 2-3. Recipe from @Sara l Nutrient Matters on Instagram.

recipes.title: Swahili Biryani
ingredients: 500g meat (beef or mutton), cut into cubes
500g onions (or 1 cup fried onions), thinly sliced
steps: Thinly slice the onions and fry until golden brown; drain on kitchen paper and keep some of the oil.
Brown the meat in the pot with a little of the onion oil. Add tomato paste and blended tomatoes.
Mix in cumin, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, salt, pepper, ginger paste and garlic paste.
Whip the yogurt smooth, add it with 1 tsp salt and cook about 10 minutes. Stir in the fried onions; add a little water if too dry.
Peel and quarter the potatoes and soak in water with 1 tbsp turmeric.
Once the meat is tender, add the potatoes and a little turmeric water and cook until the potatoes are soft. Add the banana.
Rinse the basmati until the water runs clear (soaking 30 min is suggested in the video). Boil 6 cups water, add rice, oil or butter and salt, and cook 8-10 minutes until just tender. Drain if needed.
Mix 2 tbsp water with 1/2 tsp turmeric and the saffron, and drizzle over parts of the rice for yellow streaks. Cover and steam on low 5-7 minutes.
Serve the meat and potatoes with the rice, topped with caramelized onions and coriander.
recipes.notes: Contains beef as written ("beef or mutton"); use lamb/mutton or chicken to avoid beef. Omani sea salt and whipped buttermilk in the video; diluted Greek yogurt works. Mint is optional. Recipe from Vanessa Loy-Mehri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Yemeni Fahsa
steps: Heat a little oil and fry the white and green onions until fragrant.
Add the 750 g beef and stir about 7 minutes.
Add the chili peppers, garlic, tomato, mixed spices, coriander, black pepper, cardamom and tomato paste.
Add about 1/2 liter boiling water and salt, cover and cook until the meat is tender.
Take the meat out to a dish and dry it over low heat, then mash it (fahsa).
Pour some of the broth over the meat and serve bubbling hot with tanoor bread.
recipes.notes: Translated from Arabic; abbreviations in the caption expand to tbsp (م.ك) and tsp (م.ص). Recipe from @haitham on Instagram.

recipes.title: Yemeni Fahsa
ingredients: 1 kg (2 lb) boneless beef chunks (or lamb)
steps: Chop the spring onions, garlic and tomatoes. Saute the onions and garlic in a drizzle of olive oil, add the chilies.
When fragrant, add the beef chunks and brown 5-6 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cardamom and cinnamon, then the tomato puree and chopped tomatoes; stir about 5 minutes.
Add the 4 cups boiling water, bring to a bubble, reduce to medium-low, cover and cook about 1.5 hours until the meat is falling apart.
Move the meat to a skillet and shred with a fork. Add a generous pinch of salt and about a cup of the sauce and stir gently over medium heat until bubbling.
Top with creamy sahawiq hilba and serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Contains beef as written; the creator says lamb or even camel works. The sahawiq hilba recipe is not given here. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Yogurt-Marinated Air Fryer Chicken
ingredients: Oil, for rubbing (optional; creator says none is needed)
steps: Pat the chicken dry and pound the thicker end so the breasts are even.
Spread the Greek yogurt over the chicken, add lemon juice, garlic and seasonings, and rub to coat. Marinate at least 30 minutes, up to 24 hours.
Preheat air fryer to 375F. Arrange chicken in a single layer, smooth side down. Cook 8 minutes, flip, and cook 4-7 more minutes until golden and 165F inside.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and serve.
recipes.notes: Can also be grilled or baked. Recipe from Yumna (Feel Good Foodie) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Baked Lentil Falafel with Tahini Sauce
steps: Soak the lentils in hot water for 1 hour and drain.
Pulse shallot, garlic and cilantro. Add lentils, oil and spices and pulse to a slightly chunky texture.
Add the flour, form into balls and bake at 400F for 20 minutes.
Whisk the tahini sauce ingredients, thinning with water as needed.
Serve with naan, cucumbers, spinach, tahini sauce and sriracha.
recipes.notes: Gluten-free as written. Recipe from @waytohealthkitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Pan-Fried Onigirazu
ingredients: 1 tsp sriracha, plus more to taste
3 cups cooked short-grain white rice, seasoned with salt
steps: Mix the tuna with mayo, sriracha, salt and pepper; set aside.
Fry the eggs and prep all fillings.
Dip 2 rice paper sheets in warm water and overlap them on a cutting board. Layer 2 nori sheets on top.
Cut 2 slits to make 4 sections. Put rice in one, tuna across from it, egg in the third, avocado and cucumber in the fourth.
Fold rice over the avocado, that stack onto the tuna, tuna over the egg, egg over the rice, and rice over the cucumber.
Wrap the square in 2 more wet rice paper sheets, press to seal, sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Pan fry in neutral oil on medium-high heat, searing all sides until golden and crispy.
Slice in half and serve.
recipes.notes: Free recipe on their Substack. Makes about 6 sandwiches if using 2 nori and 4 rice paper sheets each. Recipe from @Wayne & Nancy on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crunchy Edamame Salad
steps: Cook the quinoa according to package directions and let cool.
Mix all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
Roast the peanuts in a skillet for a few minutes.
Chop the salad ingredients, assemble with quinoa, edamame and peanuts, toss with dressing and serve with lime and cilantro.
recipes.notes: Per serving (creator): 485 cal, 26g fat, 30g carbs, 26g protein. Good for meal prep. Recipe from Jenny Bolle on Instagram.

recipes.title: Curry Chickpea Sandwich
ingredients: bread or bagels and sandwich toppings
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and add to the chickpeas; mash slightly.
Add the tahini, sriracha, curry, paprika, salt, lemon juice and agave and mix to combine.
Add parsley or cilantro if you like.
Build the sandwich with whatever toppings you want.
recipes.notes: German version of the caption also lists 1 tsp cumin. Recipe from @maya.plantbased on Instagram.

recipes.title: Giant Bang Bang Summer Roll
ingredients: tofu, cut into strips and pan fried
steps: Make a bang bang sauce, using vegan yogurt in place of mayo.
Julienne the cucumber and carrot; thinly slice the cabbage and avocado.
Cut the tofu into strips and pan fry until crispy.
Soak 3 sheets of rice paper in water and overlap them.
Fill with the veggies and tofu, roll up into one big roll and dunk in the sauce.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Sauce ingredients and tofu seasoning are in the full recipe at the link in the creator's bio. Recipe from Ma’ayan Moss on Instagram.

recipes.title: Green Minty Garlicky Chicken Salad Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, skin and bones removed, meat shredded
steps: Blend the mint, basil, mayo, garlic, ginger, lime juice and zest, sugar and coriander with an immersion blender or food processor until smooth and bright green. Season with salt and pepper; add more sugar or salt to balance.
Shred the chicken with two forks, using white meat and some thigh or leg meat.
Toss the chicken with the dressing, taste and adjust, then cover and chill until ready to use.
Scoop out some of the bread, fill, and add potato chips if desired.
recipes.notes: Scooping the bread is optional. Recipe from @4789542472 (Nasim Lahbichi) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Human Kibble (High-Fiber Meal Prep)
steps: Start the rice on the stove since it takes longest.
Boil the black beans and yellow or green peas.
Chop the broccoli, carrots, zucchini and onions (plus any leftover vegetables) and saute in the biggest pot with salt to draw out moisture.
Cook a large batch of eggs, at least one per serving.
Combine everything in a large bowl and portion into about 10 servings.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Per serving about 400 cal, 20 g protein, 70 g carbs, 10 g fiber, 10 g fat. Quantities are on pattyplates.com (or via DM). Pairs with chicken or beef. Recipe from Patrick Kong on Instagram.

recipes.title: Quick Falafel Wrap
steps: Blend the parsley, onion and garlic until chunky.
Add the remaining filling ingredients and blend 2-3 minutes; adjust seasoning.
Mix the tahini sauce ingredients, adding water to thin.
Add the chickpea filling, tahini sauce and tomatoes to a wrap and roll.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @maya.plantbased on Instagram.

recipes.title: Smashed Peas on Toast
steps: Blitz the peas with garlic, fresh mint, lemon, tahini, chilli powder and olive oil until smooth or chunky.
Spread on toast.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities given in the reel; full recipe is on the creator's website (link in bio) or via DM. Creator says it has more protein than avocado toast. Recipe from Gina Burgess on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Salmon Nori Wrap
ingredients: 1 (5 oz) can salmon (or shredded baked salmon)
1/2 cup steamed white or brown rice
steps: Combine salmon, mayonnaise and sriracha; season with salt and pepper.
Place a nori sheet on a clean surface and cut from the middle of one side to the center of the sheet.
In the bottom left quadrant spread 1/4 cup rice (wet hands help) and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp furikake.
On the top left quadrant spread half the salmon mixture.
On the top right quadrant lay half the cucumber in a thin layer.
On the last quadrant add half the avocado and top with 1/2 tsp furikake.
Starting from the rice, fold up, then right, then down into a neat square. Repeat with the second sheet.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @spoonforkbacon on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Onigiri
steps: Season the sushi rice with rice wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar.
Mix the drained tuna with mayo and sriracha.
With wet hands, shape a rice ball around the tuna, adding avocado and more rice on top, and form a triangle.
Brush both sides with cooking oil, press into furikake seasoning and hold together with a strip of nori.
Sear/crisp in a pan until golden (the video implies this; no timing given).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities were given. Recipe from Michelle Loveli Belfrey on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Chickpea Salad with Tahini Dressing
ingredients: Olive oil and spices (Cajun mix used)
steps: Chop the sweet potato into cubes, toss with olive oil and spices, and air fry at 200C for 10-12 minutes or bake at 220C for 25-30 minutes.
Chop the other vegetables and parsley.
Whisk the dressing ingredients.
Combine everything in a bowl and toss with the dressing.
recipes.notes: Caption is bilingual English/Arabic. Recipe from Samara Alkhammach on Instagram.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Tofu Sushi Wrap
ingredients: sushi rice seasoned with vinegar (and sugar)
baked tofu marinated in soy sauce and ginger
steps: Run the rice paper briefly under water and lay it on top of a nori sheet.
Cut halfway through the middle and add the fillings in the quarters.
Fold up and eat.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts. Rice paper is optional; skip it if you do not want the chewiness. Recipe from @sianelyse on Instagram.

recipes.title: Vegan Vietnamese-Style Instant Noodle Cups
steps: Put all the ingredients in a heatproof glass container and store in the fridge.
When ready to eat, add about 2 cups boiling water, cover and let sit 10 minutes.
Stir well to dissolve the miso and enjoy.
recipes.notes: Make one serving first and adjust the broth to your taste. Use very thin vegetables. Recipe from reen (vegetarian food blogger) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Arayes with Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb, beef or chicken
steps: Mix all the filling ingredients together.
Cut the mini pitas in half, stuff with the mixture, then cut in half again to get four pieces per pita.
Heat a cast iron pan with the oil over LOW heat and cook each side a few minutes, about 15 minutes total, without burning. If the meat is not cooked through, finish in the oven 5-6 minutes at 350F.
Mix the tahini sauce ingredients.
Serve the arayes with the tahini sauce and hot sauce.
recipes.notes: Use ground lamb or chicken to avoid beef. Recipe from @chhayajoshi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush (Mutabal)
ingredients: Parsley and sweet paprika, to finish (optional)
steps: Wash the eggplants, halve them and score the flesh. Season with salt and pepper, drizzle with olive oil and place skin side up on a parchment-lined tray.
Roast in a preheated 180C oven for 35 minutes (top and bottom heat) and cool about 15 minutes. Alternatively char on a grill or flame for a more traditional version.
Scoop out the pulp and combine with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt and pepper. Mash with a fork or mortar, or pulse briefly in a food processor for a creamier texture.
Add the olive oil (in a thin stream if mashing by hand) and emulsify.
Serve on a plate topped with paprika, parsley and olive oil.
recipes.notes: Original caption is in Spanish. Recipe from Poesia de fogon on Instagram.

recipes.title: Broad Bean Mutabal (Mtabbal Ful Akhdar)
steps: Remove the outer shell of the broad beans (optional but smoother). Boil about 10 minutes with the sugar and a pinch of salt until soft.
Mix the beans with salt, pepper, yogurt, olive oil, garlic and parsley.
Mash with a fork for chunky or blend for creamy. Add a squeeze of lemon and adjust seasoning.
Make a well in the middle, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with sumac. Serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Yogurt is optional (leave out for vegan). Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ceviche with Mango Salsa
steps: Cube the fish and put it in a bowl with lime juice and a little orange juice. Let it cure about an hour.
Make the salsa from cucumber, jicama, red onion, jalapeno, cilantro and mango.
Drain the old lime juice off the fish, mix the fish with the salsa and some fresh lime juice.
Serve with avocado and chips.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Recipe from @chefadamglick on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Fried Enoki Mushrooms
steps: Mix the dry ingredients thoroughly, then stir in the water to make a batter.
Wash the enoki and cut into flat pieces.
Dip each piece in the batter and deep fry until golden brown and crispy.
Drain excess oil and serve, e.g. with gochujang mayo.
recipes.notes: Frying temperature not given. Recipe from @rhianmelvin on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fried Sushi Sandwich
steps: Cook the rice, then mix with the seasoned rice wine vinegar.
Mix shredded imitation crab with cucumber, mayo, sriracha and soy sauce; chop.
Season shrimp and cook a few minutes per side with soy sauce.
Spread a thin layer of rice on a nori quarter, flip, and layer cream cheese, shrimp, crab salad and avocado.
Top with another nori sheet with a dab of cream cheese.
Make a thin batter of flour, cornstarch and water; dip sandwich, then coat in panko. Freeze 15 minutes.
Fry in 350F oil for 5-6 minutes total.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts for mayo, sriracha, soy and shrimp not given. Recipe from @75725398734 (Vincenzo Patriarca) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Green Chutney Hummus
ingredients: 1 (15.5 oz) can chickpeas, drained but not rinsed
1/2 inch knob ginger, peeled and grated
1 bunch cilantro, tender stems okay, plus extra for garnish
1/4 cup cold water, plus 3-4 tsp more
steps: In a food processor or blender, combine the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and ginger. Pulse 4-5 times; the mixture will seize.
Add the cilantro, mint, cumin, salt, chile if using, and 1/4 cup cold water. Blend until smooth.
Add another 3-4 tsp cold water and blend 2-3 more times until velvety. Adjust water, lemon and salt. Transfer to a bowl.
Heat the oil in a small pan until it shimmers; add the cumin seeds, swirl a few seconds, add the garlic, remove from the heat and swirl until golden.
Pour the tadka over the hummus, garnish with cilantro.
recipes.notes: Episode 2 of the Dada Hummus series. Recipe from Samah Dada (@dadaeats) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Hummus with Meat (Hummus b'Lahmeh)
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of water overnight; they will triple in size.
Transfer to a pot with fresh water and a little baking soda, bring to a boil, skim, and cook about 1 hour until very tender.
Rinse in cold water to bring the skins to the surface and remove them; drain.
Blend in a food processor with tahini into a lumpy puree, add ice or cold water for a quick blend, then lemon juice and a generous pinch of salt. Scrape down and blend again.
Spread on a plate with a well in the center.
Sear cubed steak in very hot ghee with a pinch of salt (and pine nuts if using). Spoon on top and finish with smoked paprika. Serve with pita.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are on thegoldenbalance.com (titled HUMMUS). Family version uses no olive oil, garlic optional. The topping is beef (cubed steak); skip it or swap in another protein. Recipe from Ahmad Alzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Kamouneh Banadoura (Southern Lebanese Raw Bulgur and Tomato)
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more to serve
steps: Blend the bulgur with half the onion, one tomato, the basil, mint, cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Finely chop the other half of the onion and the remaining 3 tomatoes and add them to a bowl with the blended mix and the tomato puree. Knead until properly mixed.
Taste for seasoning and chill in the fridge about 30 minutes so the bulgur absorbs the tomato juices.
Serve on a plate with a drizzle of olive oil, with bread, a fork or onion slices.
recipes.notes: Some seasonings from southern Lebanon were omitted and a Lebanese auntie said it is fine without them. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Kashke Bademjan (Persian Eggplant Dip)
ingredients: kashk (or substitute: soaked cashews blended with lemon juice and salt)
steps: Salt the eggplant and let sit 20 minutes to draw out moisture and bitterness.
Roast the eggplant with plenty of oil until golden and sweet.
Meanwhile cook the chopped onions until deeply caramelized.
Add garlic, chopped walnuts, dried mint and turmeric to the onions.
Mash the roasted eggplant with the onion mixture.
Stir in kashk, or the cashew version.
Make mint oil by frying dried mint in oil about a minute and drizzle over.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe on his website (link in bio). Vegan kashk: soaked cashews blended with lemon and salt. Kashk is fermented whey, not cheese. Recipe from @Zachary Neman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Loaded Bread Dipping Oil
ingredients: 1 heaped tbsp sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped
1 heaped tbsp chargrilled artichokes, finely chopped
1 heaped tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
steps: Combine everything in a shallow bowl and stir.
Serve with bread for dipping.
recipes.notes: Customize with a salty, sweet, spicy, acidic, fresh and umami element. Inspired by @legallyplantbased. Recipe from Zena Kamgaing on Instagram.

recipes.title: Michelin-Style Silky Hummus
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight in salted water.
Drain and rinse several times, then pressure cook covered in plenty of water for 30 minutes (or about 2 hours on the stove).
Drain, saving the chickpea water.
Blend the chickpeas with just enough chickpea water to get a very smooth mix, then cool covered in the fridge overnight.
Freeze a little of the leftover chickpea water overnight.
Day 3: blend the chilled chickpea mix with some frozen chickpea water until it comes together.
Add tahini and lemon juice, then salt and a little oil for gloss.
Taste and adjust; lacking flavor usually means more salt or tahini.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. No baking soda or skin removal needed. Serve with homemade pita. Recipe from @56128014843 (Fork the People) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Miso Butterbeans with Crispy Soy Mushrooms
ingredients: handful of spring onion and chives
steps: Tear the mushrooms roughly, douse in soy sauce and roast until very crispy.
Saute the onion and garlic until caramelised.
Add to a food processor with the drained beans, miso and plant milk; blitz until very smooth.
Spread the puree on a plate and top with the mushrooms, chilli oil, chives and spring onion.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No oven temperature or roasting time given. Recipe from @natalia.rudin on Instagram.

recipes.title: Muhammara (Roasted Red Pepper and Walnut Dip)
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers, roasted and peeled
1 tbsp chicken seasoning blend (creator used nutritional yeast)
1/4 cup pomegranate molasses (creator used balsamic glaze)
1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil (creator used 1/4 cup)
steps: Pulse the nuts in a food processor until well chopped.
Add the remaining ingredients and pulse until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve with pita or flatbread.
recipes.notes: From Chef Chris DeBarr, The Blue Zones American Kitchen. The creator notes this is not entirely authentic; traditional muhammara uses walnuts and no chicken seasoning. Recipe from Carleigh Bodrug on Instagram.

recipes.title: Muhammara (Walnut and Red Pepper Dip)
ingredients: big pinch of salt and pepper
steps: Dice the peppers and tomatoes, removing the pepper centers, and roast with the garlic until charred and the garlic is golden.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for a few minutes.
Blend the walnuts with the roasted vegetables, garlic and dried spices.
Mix in breadcrumbs until it reaches the thickness you like.
Top with the garnishes and serve with warm bread or pita.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Roasting temperature and time not given. Recipe from @jacobking on Instagram.

recipes.title: Muttabal Hamwi (Layered Eggplant Dip from Hama, Syria)
ingredients: 250 g lamb backstrap (or finely diced lamb shoulder)
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, plus more to drizzle
steps: Poke the eggplants all over and char them over a gas flame, turning, until blackened (or roast at 220C about 45 min for the texture without the smoke).
Cool in a colander over a bowl, peel under cold running water, remove the tops and let drain.
Crush the garlic with salt in a bowl, add tahini and lemon juice, then the yogurt, to a smooth paste; adjust salt and lemon.
Add the eggplant flesh and beat with a pestle to a smooth but textured dip.
Cook the diced lamb in ghee, then toss with tomato paste, 7-spice, black pepper, tomatoes and olive oil (exact method continues in the creator's comments).
Spoon the lamb over the dip and top with ghee-toasted pine nuts, aleppo chili, pomegranate seeds and olive oil.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Lamb method steps were not fully in the caption. From the cookbook Sofra. Recipe from Sunday Kitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Olive and Zaatar Bread Dipping Oil
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Serve with crusty bread or warm pita; flavor improves as it sits.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @fooddolls on Instagram.

recipes.title: Onion Bhaji / Pakora with Raita
ingredients: 1 large white and red onion, thinly sliced
1 tsp turmeric / garam masala / kashmiri chili powder
steps: Combine the fritter ingredients, adding water a little at a time to make a semi-thick batter.
Fry at 165C until crispy and golden; drain on a paper towel or wire rack.
Mix the raita ingredients, squeezing the cucumber dry in cheesecloth or a towel first.
Serve the fritters with the raita.
recipes.notes: Creator corrected the video: the flour is besan (chickpea), not suji/semolina. Recipe from @jujumao on Instagram.

recipes.title: Palestinian Hummus
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight, rinse, and boil in fresh water with baking soda for about 1.5 hours until very soft.
Drain, keeping the cooking water.
Blend the chickpeas with lemon, garlic, salt, tahini and chickpea water until super creamy; add ice cubes if the blender struggles.
Spread, top with soft chickpeas and parsley, make a paprika imprint with a wet fork dipped in paprika, and finish with olive oil.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Creator based it on the hummus at Akilah in Gaza City. Recipe from @palestinianvideos on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peruvian Ceviche with Chili Crunch Leche de Tigre
steps: Blend the aromatics, fish trim, aji amarillo paste and chili crunch together.
Strain, then adjust with salt and lime juice.
Lay the marinated fish and onions in a serving dish and pour the leche de tigre over.
Top with cilantro, chopped chilies and more chili crunch.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities given; step-by-step is sent via DM (comment RECIPE). Recipe from @16994352009 (Momofuku Goods) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Roasted Beet Hummus
ingredients: 1 large beet, peeled and roughly chopped
1 large carrot, peeled and roughly chopped
1 small head of garlic, ends chopped off
Oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder (for roasting)
Salt, pepper and garlic powder, to taste
steps: Toss the beet, carrot, cauliflower and garlic head with oil, salt, pepper and garlic powder and roast at 425F for 30 minutes.
Transfer to a food processor or blender, add the lemon juice, chickpeas, tahini, olive oil and seasonings, and blend.
Serve.
recipes.notes: Squeeze the roasted garlic from the skins before blending (implied). Health claims are the creator's. Recipe from Jovana Vuckovic on Instagram.

recipes.title: Salatat Om Houria (Tunisian Carrot Dip)
ingredients: 1 tbsp harissa paste or chopped chili
steps: Peel and chop the carrots and boil about 10 minutes until fork tender (boil eggs alongside for extra protein).
Fry the diced onion and garlic in olive oil, then add the harissa.
Add the carrots, salt, pepper, cumin, vinegar and a squeeze of lemon.
Mash with a potato masher or fork and drizzle in more olive oil until soft and creamy.
Spread on a plate, top with sliced boiled eggs and olives, drizzle with olive oil and serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Serve with bread and tea. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sushi Bundt Cake
steps: Mix the rice vinegar, sugar and salt, stir into the cooked rice with the sesame seeds and cool completely, ideally overnight.
Chop the salmon and tuna and mix with the Japanese mayo, sriracha, sesame oil, tamari and scallion greens.
Assemble in a bundt pan: rice on the bottom, cucumber, spicy fish mixture, avocado, then press in the rest of the rice. Flip onto a plate.
Mix the scallion whites, chopped serrano, orange and lemon juice and tamari to taste for the sauce.
Top the cake with nori pieces, togarashi and sliced serrano and serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Raw tuna and salmon should be sushi-grade. A popular dish from Obregon, Sonora, Mexico. Recipe from Nadia Aidi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Toum (Lebanese Garlic Sauce)
steps: Blitz the garlic and salt in a food processor, scraping the sides, until a paste forms.
With the processor running, gently stream in the oil. Halfway through, alternate between lemon juice and oil.
Continue until you have a silky smooth, fluffy white paste. Do not stop the processor once you start pouring the oil.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Quantities are in the full recipe linked in the creator's bio. Great with bread, chicken and as a dip. Recipe from Antony Khoury | Love at First Bite on Instagram.

recipes.title: Zaalouk (Moroccan Eggplant Dip)
steps: Grill or roast the vegetables, turning every 15 minutes (about 40 minutes), or char them over a stove flame for smokiness.
Cover and let cool completely, then peel off the skins and chop finely.
Fry the garlic and chili in olive oil and start mashing.
Add each vegetable one at a time, mashing a couple of minutes before the next.
Stir on medium-high heat until the juices evaporate.
Season with salt, cumin, olive oil and the parsley.
Plate with a well in the middle, drench with olive oil and serve with bread.
recipes.notes: Amounts can vary; use mostly eggplant. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Accordion Potatoes
steps: Choose large potatoes. Cut them with the accordion method: cut across, flip, cut again, then cut lengthwise into finger-like pieces.
Toss the potatoes with olive oil and the spice mix.
Cook in the oven or air fryer until tender and golden.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Quantities, temperature and time are not given. Narration is in Arabic. Recipe from Aziz Alreshoud on Instagram.

recipes.title: Aleppo Eggplant and Tomato (Makmoor Batenjan)
ingredients: Pita bread and spicy peppers, to serve
steps: Cut strips into the eggplant skin, then cut into large cubes. Toss in a bowl with a generous drizzle of olive oil, salt, pepper, cumin and coriander.
Air fry at 400F about 20 minutes, tossing halfway.
In a pot, saute the onions in a generous amount of olive oil with salt and pepper until soft.
Add the tomatoes, season again, cover and simmer about 15 minutes until the liquid has mostly dried up.
Stir in the cooked eggplant, cover and simmer another 5-10 minutes until all the liquid is gone and only the oil is left.
Adjust salt; serve warm or cold with pita and spicy peppers.
recipes.notes: Traditionally the eggplant (and sometimes onion) is deep fried and finished in the oven; this is a stovetop simplification. Cumin and coriander are the creator's father's addition. Recipe from Bayan's kitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Avocado Rice
steps: Cook the rice according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 400F. Roast the garlic and shallots with a little oil and salt about 20 minutes until soft; let cool.
Blend the olive oil, cilantro, lime juice, soy sauce, chicken broth, herbs, coriander, cumin, avocado and roasted garlic and shallots until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the rice and mix until coated; add more lime to taste.
Portion into meal prep containers or serve with a protein.
recipes.notes: Creator compares it to guacamole rice. Recipe from Trevor Thomas on Instagram.

recipes.title: Blistered Garlic Green Beans with Lemon-Sesame Glaze
ingredients: 2 tbsp sugar or honey (creator used coconut sugar)
2 small lemons, zested and juiced (1 if you dislike tang)
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the green beans 5-7 minutes until bright green and crisp.
Drain and immediately move to ice water.
Process the garlic with some of the oil until spoonable.
Heat a wide skillet or wok over high heat, add oil to coat the bottom. When shimmering, add beans in a single layer.
Leave undisturbed 1-2 minutes until blistered, toss and repeat once more. Work in batches.
Add the garlic to the pan, cook and toss 1-2 minutes until fragrant, then move beans to a serving bowl.
In the same pan add soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil and toss quickly until glossy and the sugar melts.
Pour over the beans, add lemon zest and juice and salt generously. Serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Creator's tip: get a good char while keeping crunch. Sugar can be swapped for honey or maple syrup. Recipe from Sarah M Lasry - EASY RECIPES & TRAVEL on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Sweet Potato Fries with Spicy Aioli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb sweet potatoes (2 small or 1 large)
steps: Slice the sweet potatoes into uniform 1/4 inch strips about 3 inches long (shorter crisps better). Soak in cold water at least 30 minutes, up to 6 hours.
Preheat the oven to 425F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Drain and dry the fries well. Toss with the olive oil, then the cornstarch and black pepper. Do not salt yet.
Spread on the sheets without touching or crowding.
Bake 15 minutes, flip, then bake 10-15 minutes more until golden and crispy.
Sprinkle with salt. Mix the mayo and sriracha and serve alongside.
recipes.notes: Soak 30 min at least. Salt at the end for max crispiness. Recipe from @maxinesharf on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Oven Fries (Cornstarch Paste Method)
steps: Whisk the cornstarch into the water and microwave for a couple of minutes, whisking frequently, until it thickens into a paste.
Coat the potato wedges in the paste.
Bake in a hot oven until crisp outside and tender inside.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Oven temperature, time and potato quantity not given in the reel. Recipe from America's Test Kitchen (technique by Gitsini) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Extra Crispy Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 large onions, cut into 1 cm rings
steps: Remove the inner membrane from the onion rings.
Chill the rings in iced water while you make the batter.
Mix the flours, seasonings, sparkling water and vodka into a smooth batter.
Dry the rings, dip in the batter, then coat in the panko.
Heat oil to 170C/340F and fry in batches, about 5 minutes, so the temperature does not drop.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @thombateman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fattoush (His Mom's Recipe)
ingredients: romaine lettuce, cut into thin strips
fresh pita, cut in strips then cubes
steps: Slice the romaine into thin strips and put in a serving bowl.
Add radish matchsticks, cucumber half-coins and bell pepper; put cherry tomatoes on top so they don't make the lettuce soggy.
Add green onion, fresh mint and parsley.
Make the dressing with 1 part lemon to 3 parts olive oil, grated garlic, salt and pomegranate molasses; it keeps in a jar for the week.
Fry pita cubes in very hot olive oil and season with za'atar near the end.
Dress the salad, toss gently, top with the chips, dried mint and a drizzle of pomegranate molasses.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Recipe from Ahmad Alzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fondant Potatoes
steps: Cut russets into 1-inch rounds and cut cylinders with a ring mold. Soak 20 minutes, pat very dry and season with salt.
Sear in a stainless pan with oil for 2-3 minutes on the first side until golden.
Flip, lower the heat, and add butter, thyme, crushed garlic and rosemary.
When the butter is frothy, add stock until the potatoes are half submerged.
Roast in a 400F oven for 20 minutes until fork tender.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities; full recipe at kellyscleankitchen.com. Recipe from @kellyscleankitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Melting Cabbage
steps: Sear the cabbage wedge, then transfer to a large baking dish.
Saute shallots and garlic in butter.
Add chicken broth, heavy cream, parmesan, chili oil and oregano.
Pour the sauce over the cabbage.
Bake until super soft and tender.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts or temperature given; creator's full recipe is via DM or search 'herman at home melting cabbage'. Recipe from Herman at Home on Instagram.

recipes.title: Garlic Smashed Cucumbers
steps: Put the cucumbers in a large ziplock bag or under plastic wrap and smash with a mallet into irregular ~1 inch pieces.
Place in a colander, sprinkle generously with salt and drain 30 minutes, pressing occasionally.
Meanwhile, mix the garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, salt, Thai chili and sesame oil.
Transfer the cucumbers to a bowl, pour the sauce over, toss, and top with cilantro.
recipes.notes: 10 min prep plus 30 min draining. Recipe from Maxine Sharf on Instagram.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric Rice
steps: Add rice, water, turmeric, cumin and salt to the rice cooker.
Mix, close the lid and start the rice cooker.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Rice-to-water ratio not given. Recipe from @55356685 (Brian Bidanjiri) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Green Almond and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh green almonds, thinly sliced
1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, loosely chopped
1/2 to 1 small red onion, very thinly sliced
steps: Wash and dry everything well. Thinly slice the green almonds and red onion.
In a large bowl combine green almonds, purslane, parsley, arugula, mint and oregano.
Add the sliced onion, then sprinkle in salt and sumac.
Pour in the lemon juice and olive oil.
Toss gently, just until coated; overworking will bruise the herbs.
Taste and adjust salt, lemon or sumac.
Serve immediately while crisp.
recipes.notes: Made with Jenin olive oil from @canaan.palestine. Recipe from @75847522413 (Azza) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Life-Changing Lettuce
ingredients: olive oil (two pours around the bowl)
steps: Chop the iceberg lettuce into a bowl.
Add lemon juice, olive oil, salt, the garlic and a splash of white vinegar.
Mix well so the garlic is evenly distributed; adjust to taste.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are approximate; creator says you cannot really measure it. Recipe from @bakedbymelissa on Instagram (Baked by Melissa).

recipes.title: M'sayar (Libyan Lemon Pickles)
steps: Pack sliced cucumber and fennel in a jar.
Add salt, citric acid and lemon juice, then fill with water.
Shake and let it sit; it improves over time.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts or timing given; full recipe via link in bio. Recipe from Jake Goldberg on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pickled Radishes with Beets
ingredients: 4 Serrano chilies, sliced into thin circles (optional)
8 tbsp kosher salt (2 tbsp per jar)
2 cups white distilled vinegar (1/2 cup per jar)
room temperature filtered water, to fill jars
steps: Trim and wash the radishes; scrub the beets and slice into thin half-moons.
In each jar layer a few beet slices, radishes to halfway, 1 tsp sliced Serrano, 1 bay leaf, more beet slices, then pack with whole radishes.
To each jar add 2 tbsp kosher salt, 1 tsp peppercorns and 1/2 cup vinegar.
Top with filtered water, leaving about 1/2 inch of space at the top.
Seal tightly and shake; leave on the counter 2 days.
Refrigerate; enjoy within 1-2 months.
recipes.notes: Beets give the pink color. Recipe from Sivan's Kitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Quick Homemade Pickles (Mukhallal)
steps: Stir the water, apple cider vinegar and salt until the salt mostly dissolves.
Trim the top end off each cucumber and pack the cucumbers (halved or whole) into a jar, adding garlic or herbs if you like.
Pour the brine over the vegetables to the top and close the jar.
Leave about 3 days before eating, then store.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Creator says ready in about 3 to 4 days; her storage advice was cut off in the transcript. Recipe from Rasha Mektepli on Instagram.

recipes.title: Rice with Vermicelli (Riz a Shaariyeh)
steps: Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Add the ghee to a pot, crush the vermicelli nests in your hands into the pot and cook until the noodles turn light brown.
Add the rice, 3 cups water and season well with salt.
Cover with the lid and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, simmer on low for about 25 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the water has evaporated completely.
recipes.notes: Great with yogurt on the side, or alongside a tray bake or casserole. Recipe from Sunday Kitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sesame Coconut Flatbread (Mkate wa Futa)
ingredients: 3 cups coconut milk (you might need less)
Melted butter or ghee, for brushing
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, salt, yeast, baking powder and milk powder in a large bowl.
Add the coconut milk gradually and mix until a smooth batter; not too runny or too stiff.
Cover and let rise 1 hour or until doubled.
Mix 2 tsp salt into 1 cup water. Heat a cast-iron or stainless steel pan (not non-stick).
Sprinkle salt water on the hot pan, spread a handful of batter into a circle, sprinkle sesame seeds and cover.
Cook until the top is dry, then flip the pan over to cook the top side to a light char.
Lift off with a metal spatula, brush with melted butter, and cover while cooking the rest.
recipes.notes: Traditionally cooked over charcoal; the creator uses a pan. Good with curry or grilled meat. Brush both sides with butter. Recipe from Vanessa Loy-Mehri on Instagram.

recipes.title: Shortcut Persian Flatbread (Sangak-Style)
ingredients: extra virgin olive oil, for stretching
steps: Mix the warm water, instant yeast, za'atar, olive oil, salt and Greek yogurt into a dough.
Rest for 90 minutes.
Punch down and divide into 16 pieces.
Stretch each piece with olive oil and cook on high heat until charred in spots.
Top with nigella seeds.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe via DM (comment 'SANGAK'). Not traditional sangak. Freezes well and reheats from the pan. Recipe from Solmaz Saberi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the burghul in warm water (about 1 inch above it) for 30 minutes.
Chop the tomatoes very small and let them sit in a strainer with a little salt for 15 minutes. Discard half the juice and save half.
Chop the scallions, cucumber and mint.
Remove the parsley leaves from the stems and chop very small with a sharp knife.
Mix the lemon juice with the saved tomato juice, dried mint, salt and pepper.
Drain the burghul, combine everything and add olive oil at the very end. Serve with romaine leaves.
recipes.notes: Cucumber is optional and not in every tabbouleh. Olive oil is added to taste (no amount given). Recipe from @nadiaaidi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Tahdig (Persian Crispy Rice)
steps: Wash the basmati and jasmine rice 8 to 10 times until the water is mostly clear.
Boil water with chicken bouillon, cardamom pods, salt and olive oil, add the rice, and cook about 7 minutes until al dente.
Drain and rinse with cold water.
In the same pot, heat ghee, olive oil, saffron water and turmeric, then add the part-cooked rice.
Press the rice flat with your hands, poke a few holes, and cover with a towel-wrapped lid.
Cook on medium-high, then medium, for 45 minutes until the bottom is crisp (you can hear and see it).
Place a flush-fitting serving tray over the pot and flip in one quick motion.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; full recipe is on her website. Recipe from @nutrientmatters on Instagram (Sara, Nutrient Matters).

recipes.title: Trini Buss Up Shut (Paratha Roti)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups warm water, or slightly more
1/3 cup butter or ghee, for spreading between layers
1/4 cup ghee, butter or oil, for basting
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, add the ghee and warm water, and knead into a dough.
Divide into six pieces, cover and rest 30 minutes.
Roll each piece thin (it need not be round), spread with ghee or butter, dust with a little flour, cut from the center to the edge and form a cone.
Oil the cones, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Roll each out again and fry in a cast iron pan until golden with crispy specks, basting both sides with butter or ghee and watching the heat.
Bust it up (clap it) to show the layers if you like, and serve with curry.
recipes.notes: Called paratha, roti or buss up shut in Trinidad. Original recipe by @immaculatebites. Recipe from Travelandmunchies on Instagram.

recipes.title: All-Purpose 75% Hydration Dough (Pizza, Pita, Sesame Pancake, Rolls)
steps: Knead the dough and refrigerate overnight to ferment.
Divide into pieces and roll into dough balls; proof 1-2 hours.
Pizza: shape into a circle, add sauce, mozzarella and basil and bake.
Pita: roll slightly thicker than pizza and bake.
Sesame pancake: roll flat, coat in sesame seeds and pan-fry in oil on both sides.
Roll: shape, proof a bit longer, score and bake.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Ratios of salt and yeast not stated. Skip the mozzarella for the pizza version. Recipe from @Mike Greenfield on Instagram.

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 175C (about 350F) and prep an 8x8 tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together.
Beat the sugar, brown sugar and eggs until pale and doubled in volume.
Add the salt and vanilla.
Fold in the chocolate mixture.
Sift in the flour and cocoa and fold gently, then add chopped chocolate (and nuts if using).
Bake 25-30 minutes; do not overbake. Cool, and chill overnight for the fudgiest texture.
recipes.notes: Whip eggs and sugar as long as you can for the shiny crackled top. Recipe from audrey on Instagram.

recipes.title: Creme Brulee (No Torch)
steps: Heat the cream and vanilla over low-medium heat for about 10 minutes until it starts to bubble.
Whisk the yolks, whole egg and sugar together. Slowly pour in the hot cream while whisking, then strain.
Pour into ramekins set in a baking dish and fill the dish halfway with boiling water.
Bake at 160C (about 320F) for 30-40 minutes; the center should jiggle slightly (no jiggle means overbaked).
Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
For the caramel, put the sugar and water in a pan, mix once, then do not stir again. Heat on medium-low until amber.
Pour a little caramel on each custard, swirl, and wait 1-2 minutes for it to harden.
recipes.notes: Adding a whole egg makes it creamier, says the creator. Recipe from Couffee on Instagram.

recipes.title: Easy Lebanese Baklava
ingredients: 3/4 cup ghee, melted, plus more for brushing
1 lb box phyllo sheets (9 x 14 inch), room temperature
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F. Brush the bottom of a 9x13 pan with ghee.
Unroll the phyllo and trim an inch off the ends to fit the pan.
Stir the pistachios and sugar together.
Lay down a stack of 20 phyllo sheets, then about 10 more from the second sleeve. Spread the pistachio mixture evenly and top with the remaining phyllo.
Pour the melted ghee over and tilt to spread. Cut into diamonds with 5 lengthwise and 9 diagonal crosswise cuts.
Bake 45-50 minutes until golden all the way into the cuts, rotating halfway.
Meanwhile boil the sugar, water and lemon juice, then simmer 5-7 minutes until thickened but clear. Remove from heat, add orange blossom water and cool.
Pour the cooled syrup over the baklava as soon as it comes out of the oven. Cool at room temperature at least 2 hours.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Yumna (Feel Good Foodie) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Easy Rustic Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until combined and let sit 15 minutes.
Do a set of stretch and folds, rest 30 minutes, do a second set, then cover and leave at room temperature 1 hour.
Refrigerate the dough and ferment 12-48 hours.
Preheat a baking tray (or pizza stone/steel) to 250C.
Release the dough with a scraper onto a well floured surface and cut into 4-8 pieces; optionally stretch or poke a hole in the middle.
Place on the tray and bake at 240C for 20-25 minutes until nicely colored.
Cool at least 30-60 minutes.
recipes.notes: Wet your hands to stop the dough sticking. Recipe from @herbifoods on Instagram.

recipes.title: Easy Sourdough Starter
steps: Days 1-3: once daily, add 1 tablespoon water and 1 tablespoon flour and mix.
Day 4 onward: feed twice daily with 1 tablespoon water + 1 tablespoon flour.
Keep warm (25-28C). The starter doubled on day 8 in her test.
recipes.notes: No discarding needed with this method. Optional spatula and elastic band to mark rise. Recipe from @jadelim.sourdough on Instagram.

recipes.title: No-Knead Peasant Bread (Selski Hliab)
steps: Stir the dry ingredients together, add the warm water and stir to a tacky dough.
Cover and let rise at least 5 hours.
Flour the counter, pour out the dough, flour the top and shape it.
Place in a lined baking dish with a lid and bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 30 minutes.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Oven temperature not stated; full printable recipe at themodernnonna.com. Recipe from @themodernnonna on Instagram.

recipes.title: Open-Bake Sourdough Method (Steam Setup)
steps: Put the baking steel on the center rack and the 9x13 pan on the oven floor. Preheat to 490F for one hour.
Boil a kettle of water. Loosely roll the towels and place in the 8x8 pan.
Cut parchment to the size of the peel, load loaves, score, and slide onto the hot steel.
Working quickly, set the 8x8 pan on the bottom of the oven, pour boiling water over the towels, pour about 1/4 inch of boiling water into the 9x13 pan, and shut the door fast to trap steam.
Immediately lower the oven to 450F and bake 15-20 minutes.
Remove the 9x13 pan and dump any water, return the pan, raise oven to 490F and bake another 15-20 minutes, rotating loaves for even browning. Loaves are done at 195F in the center.
For another batch, let the oven return to 490F, boil more water and repeat.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Creator bakes four loaves at once this way and says it is quicker than a Dutch oven. Adapted from @plainjane.bakes. Do not let the towels dry out; they will burn. Recipe from Anna (Bread and Butter Baking) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Overnight Homemade Pita
steps: Mix the flour, salt, olive oil, water and yeast and knead until smooth, about 7 minutes.
Cover and rise in the fridge overnight.
Divide into six balls, roll until very smooth and rest about 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 500F with a baking sheet inside.
Roll two balls at a time to about 5 inch circles on parchment and bake about 5 minutes until puffed.
recipes.notes: Based on "The Ultimate Pita" (Ottolenghi, Guardian). Recipe from Ryan Nordheimer on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pistachio Crinkles (Vegan Om Ali Style)
steps: Scrunch the filo into a greased baking tray and brush with melted butter.
Bake at 180C (about 355F) for 20-25 minutes until crisp and golden.
Pour over the condensed milk and cream and bake a further 10-20 minutes.
Sprinkle with crushed pistachios and dust with icing sugar. Cool, then serve slightly warm.
recipes.notes: Creator uses vegan condensed milk, cream and butter. Recipe from Jacob King on Instagram.

recipes.title: Saj Bread Dough (Saj Voyage)
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour (labeled suitable for bread, "zero" flour)
steps: In a large bowl combine flour, baking powder and salt; add olive oil and rub in until the flour has absorbed all the oil and no lumps remain.
In a cup, mix sugar and instant yeast, add 2/3 cup warm water, mix and leave 5 minutes.
Add the yeast mixture to the flour along with 1 cup warm water. Mix until combined, cover with plastic, and rest 10 minutes.
Turn out on a floured surface and knead briefly until smooth.
Brush with a little oil, put in an airtight container to rise, then refrigerate; keeps up to a week.
recipes.yield: Makes dough for saj bread or manakish
recipes.notes: Flour varies by country so watch the water; aim for a soft, cohesive dough. Use for saj bread, manakish, spinach pies and meat pies. Translated from Arabic. Recipe from @57142927080 (Saj Voyage) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Super Crispy Baking-Soda Potatoes
ingredients: potatoes (Yukon gold; russets also work), cut in chunks
steps: Boil the potatoes in water with salt and a little baking soda about 8 minutes, until easily pierced with a knife.
Drain and transfer to a mixing bowl; toss to rough up the surfaces.
Add butter and optional Parmesan and toss to coat.
Spread on a parchment-lined baking sheet, spaced out with minimal touching.
Bake at 425F with convection on (or use an air fryer) until golden and crispy.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Water, salt and baking soda ratios are not stated; creator points to Kenji Lopez-Alt's Serious Eats YouTube video. Parmesan is optional (skip for no cheese). Recipe from Michael Tchao on Instagram.

recipes.title: Upside Down PB Banana Bread Bars
ingredients: 1 cup dark chocolate chips or chopped dark chocolate
steps: Preheat the oven to 375F. Grease a 9x13 pan and line with parchment. Lay the sliced bananas cut side down on the parchment, trimming to fit.
Combine sugar and water in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook, shaking (not stirring) the pan, 6-8 minutes until amber caramel. Pour immediately over the bananas.
Whisk brown sugar and mashed bananas to a smooth paste, then whisk in olive oil, peanut butter, vanilla and eggs.
Add flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg; stir until just combined, then fold in the chocolate.
Pour over the caramel bananas, smooth, and bake about 30 minutes until golden and cracked, 190F internally.
Cool 15 minutes, run a knife around the edges, invert onto a board, discard parchment, slice and serve warm.
recipes.notes: Dairy-free (peanut butter replaces yogurt). Recipe from @jakecohen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Vegan Challah
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a mixer bowl with the dough hook. With the mixer running, add the oil and water.
Knead on medium speed about 10 minutes until smooth, stretchy and not sticky.
Place in a greased bowl, cover with a towel and let rise until doubled.
Punch down, divide into two, then divide each piece into four strands (two 4-braid loaves). Roll the strands, set 4 in a row and pinch the tops together.

Braid: inner right strand over the two left strands; outer right strand between the two remaining right strands; inner left over the right strands; outer left between the two remaining left strands. Repeat to the end and pinch the ends.
Place on a lined baking sheet, cover and let rise until doubled. Preheat the oven to 180C / 350F.
Mix vegan milk with maple syrup, brush on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 25-30 minutes.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @maayan.moss on Instagram.

recipes.title: 2-Ingredient Nutella Fudge
ingredients: 500 g milk chocolate, broken into chunks
420 g Nutella (or other chocolate hazelnut spread)
steps: Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring, until smooth.
Stir in the Nutella until fully combined.
Pour into an 8x8 inch tin and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Take out 5-10 minutes before slicing. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Tin size 8x8 inch. Recipe from @fitwafflekitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Banana Brownies
steps: Blend/mix the bananas, peanut butter and cocoa powder (amounts not given).
Top with chocolate chips if you like.
Bake like regular brownies.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts not given; full recipe at samdoesherbest.com. Recipe from Samantha Russo on Instagram.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Protein Cookies
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mash the banana, then fold in the peanut butter and protein powder; rest 1-2 minutes and mix again.
Scoop 6 mounds onto the sheet; the dough is sticky, so shape discs, top with chocolate chips and press lightly with a fork.
Bake 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden and the center is no longer wet.
Sprinkle with sea salt, cool 5 minutes on the pan, then move to a rack.
recipes.notes: Use runny natural peanut butter. The creator used a beef isolate protein powder (untested with others); choose a non-beef powder. Recipe from Abby on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ajwa and Cardamom Ice Cream
steps: Dry roast the cardamom pods 1-2 minutes, then add the dates and milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Blend the mixture and pass through a sieve.
Beat the egg yolks with the salt, sugar and xanthan gum.
Slowly beat the warm milk mixture into the yolks so it doesn't curdle.
Return to low heat, stirring constantly, until it is a thick custard or reaches 80C.
Remove from the heat and fold in the cream and vanilla.
Chill overnight, with the ice cream maker bowl also in the freezer.
Churn in the ice cream maker for 30 minutes.
recipes.notes: Creator links the dish to Ajwa dates in Islamic tradition; multiples of 7 dates are mentioned. Recipe from Sliced on Instagram.

recipes.title: All-Pistachio Nougat Bars
ingredients: 1/2 tsp matcha powder (or natural green coloring)
1/2 tsp matcha powder (or natural green coloring)
steps: Blend the 2 cups pistachios with matcha until a smooth butter.
Blend 1 cup pistachios, dates, sea salt and matcha into a soft nougat.
Press the nougat firmly into a lined baking tray; spread the pistachio butter over it and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.
Freeze 1 hour to set.
Cut into rectangular bars and dip each in melted dark chocolate; sprinkle with fleur de sel and chopped pistachios.
Freeze 15 more minutes to harden the chocolate.
recipes.notes: Matcha is only for green color. Recipe from Youssef Maazami on Instagram.

recipes.title: Arabic Ice Cream (Booza)
ingredients: salep: 2 tbsp per cup of milk (adjust to the strength of your salep)
steps: Mix the salep with the orange blossom water and rose water (cold).
Put the milk, milk powder, sugar, vanilla and ground mastic in a pot, add the salep mixture, and heat until it boils.
Let cool.
Whip the cream and fold it into the cooled mixture.
Freeze until it begins to set, then stir vigorously by hand with a spoon; repeat 2 to 3 times.
Spread in a tray or bag and freeze 2 to 3 hours more.
Roll or coat in chopped pistachios and serve.
recipes.notes: No ice cream machine or kneading needed. Salep amount varies by brand. Recipe from @nourghazall on Instagram (Nour Ghazall).

recipes.title: Atayef (Katayef) with Ashta
steps: Gently simmer the milk, lower the heat and add vinegar. Once it separates, strain the curds and let them cool.
Make a custard by heating cream, cornstarch, sugar, rose water and orange blossom water on medium until slightly thickened. Cool.
Mix the milk curd into the cooled custard to make ashta.
Cook the pancake batter on one side only until bubbles form and the bottom is golden.
Spread a generous spoonful of ashta on each pancake, pinch the edge closed, and dip the edge in pistachios.
Drizzle with rose and orange blossom syrup.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; the creator said the full recipe would be posted in his bio soon. He uses his favorite pancake mix rather than from-scratch batter. Recipe from Antony Khoury | Love at First Bite on Instagram.

recipes.title: Balas Baianas (Brazilian Caramel-Coated Coconut Balls)
steps: Combine the condensed milk, coconut and butter in a pan over medium heat and stir constantly until it comes together and slides easily off the pan.
Pour onto a plate and refrigerate a couple of hours, then roll into balls and return them to the fridge.
Mix the sugar, water and lemon juice off the heat, then put on the heat and do not touch until it turns an amber caramel colour.
Dip each ball in the caramel one at a time, working quickly, and set aside to harden.
recipes.notes: Creator says she could have taken the caramel off a bit earlier. Recipe from Fatimah Omran on Instagram.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cream Chocolate Bars
ingredients: a pinch of fleur de sel
steps: Blend the cream, frozen blueberries, cashews and maple syrup until smooth and creamy.
In a food processor, blend the dates, almonds and salt until soft and dough-like.
Press the nougat evenly into a lined mold. Pour the blueberry cream on top, smooth, and sprinkle with fresh blueberries.
Freeze 1 hour until firm.
Cut into rectangular bars, dip each in melted dark chocolate, and top with fleur de sel and chopped nuts.
Freeze 10 more minutes to set the chocolate.
recipes.notes: Keep stored in the freezer. Recipe from Youssef Maazami | Healthy Desserts 🍫 on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chai Saffron Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 tsp of the sugar for grinding saffron
steps: Crush the spices in a mortar. Add to a large pot with the tea bags and 1 litre water; cook on high 20 minutes, lid off, until reduced by half.
Add the evaporated milk and sugar and cook 10 more minutes. Cool completely in the pan, then strain; you want about 600ml (top up with evaporated milk or water).
Grind the saffron with 1 tsp sugar, add the ice cubes and let them melt at room temperature.

Whisk the egg whites with half the sugar to stiff peaks. In another bowl whisk the yolks with the remaining sugar until pale and thick (ribbon stage). Beat in the mascarpone and cream cheese, then the melted saffron.
Fold in half the egg whites, then the rest, then 1/4 tsp salt.

Lay half the rusks in a tray, pour over half the chai and let them absorb until pooled. Top with half the cream, then the remaining rusks, the rest of the chai, and the remaining cream. Top with pistachios.
Refrigerate 3-4 hours before serving.
recipes.notes: Contains mascarpone and cream cheese (cheese); contains raw egg whites. Cake rusks idea credited to Dish by Rish, who has an eggless version. Recipe from Seema Pankhania on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chewy Brown Sugar Boba
ingredients: 1300 grams dry boba pearls (per audio, may be 300 g)
1000 ml hot water for the syrup
steps: Boil the boba in the hot water for 25 minutes.
Let rest (duration unclear in audio).
Dissolve the dark brown sugar in the hot water and cook 7 minutes.
Soak or toss the pearls in the syrup and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Quantities come from a poor transcript and are scaled for a shop; scale down and check package directions. Recipe from @RAY LI on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chickpea Chocolate Soft Serve
steps: Drain the chickpeas and add to a blender with the cocoa, plant milk and dates.
Blend until super smooth.
Freeze about 30 minutes and serve.
recipes.notes: Creator says the whole batch has about 47 g protein. Recipe from @epicmintleaves on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chocolate Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)
ingredients: 35g (1 scoop) cookies and cream protein powder
steps: Combine the ingredients into a shake, freeze in a Ninja Creami pint, and process in the Creami (the reel does not detail the freezing and processing steps).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Steps are not shown in the audio or caption; the pint-and-spin method is the machine's normal use.
