The creator's favorite non-diet flavor is Kraft mac and cheese ice cream (410g milk, 137g heavy cream, 86g sugar, 40g Kraft powder), which contains cheese powder. Recipe from Max Coleman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chocolate Protein Pudding (Egg-Based)
ingredients: 2 tbsp sweetener of choice (he uses date sugar)
steps: Add the boiled eggs, cocoa, a bit of dark chocolate chips, vanilla and sweetener to a blender.
Add the milk and blend 2 to 3 minutes until very smooth.
Pour into containers and chill at least 2 hours.
recipes.notes: Chocolate chip amount not given. Recipe from @mohammedmoosa (Mohammed Moosa) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chocolate Strawberry Fruit Leather
steps: Preheat the oven to 180F or the lowest setting. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Blend the strawberries, honey and lemon juice until smooth.
Spread the mixture evenly on the baking sheet.
Bake for a couple of hours until the leather is no longer sticky and peels off easily.
Microwave the chocolate chips and coconut oil in 30-second increments until melted.
Cut the fruit leather into strips, brush the chocolate on top, and chill in the fridge to set.
recipes.notes: Creator says the fruit leather idea itself comes from Iran (lavashak) and he added chocolate. Recipe from @Trace's Oats on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Almond Ganache Cups
ingredients: Whipped cream with a little almond, to serve (optional)
steps: Combine the almond milk, honey, almond extract and salt in a saucepan over medium-high heat and whisk until it just begins to steam.
Put the chocolate chips in a blender, add the hot milk mixture and blend until smooth.
Divide among about 10 8-oz jars and let cool. Cover and chill overnight.
Top with whipped cream and serve.
recipes.notes: Between a pudding and a mousse in texture. Whip cream in a protein shaker for speed. Recipe from Jake Cohen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Date Cocoa Energy Balls
ingredients: crushed nuts, sesame seeds, cocoa powder or shredded coconut
steps: Blend all ingredients until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into balls and coat in your choice of toppings.
Store in the fridge up to 2 weeks or the freezer up to 3 months.
recipes.notes: Use soft dates. Pistachios, almonds and sesame suggested for coating; nice with Arabic coffee. Recipe from @samaraalkhammach on Instagram.

recipes.title: Flourless Protein Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter (or other nut butter)
steps: Coat an 8-inch square baking dish with oil spray and preheat the oven to 350F.
Mash the bananas and stir in the peanut butter until smooth (some banana lumps are fine). Add the egg.
Stir in the protein powder and cocoa until well combined and creamy.
Spread in the dish, smooth, and tap on the counter a few times.
Bake on the middle rack about 25 minutes. Cool at least 10 minutes and cut into 9 squares.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @joybauer on Instagram.

recipes.title: Frozen Grapes and Grape Sorbet
steps: Pick the grapes and wash them.
Squeeze lemon juice over the grapes and sprinkle with caster sugar.
Freeze overnight.
Eat the frozen grapes with a fork, or blitz them into a zingy sorbet.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Grapes ripen all at once and don't keep long, hence freezing. No amounts given. Recipe from Martha Swales on Instagram.

recipes.title: Frozen Pistachio, Date and Yogurt Chocolate Bites
ingredients: 1 cup roasted pistachios, plus more for topping
1 tsp sea salt, plus more for topping
steps: Blend everything except the chocolate chips in a food processor until smooth and creamy.
Pipe into silicone half-sphere molds (or drop rounded spoonfuls onto parchment) and freeze overnight.
Melt the chocolate and fully coat the frozen bites on parchment, then immediately top with chopped pistachios and sea salt before it hardens.
Enjoy promptly or store in an airtight container in the freezer.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Misha on Instagram.

recipes.title: Grilled Pineapple with Butterscotch
steps: Heat the butter, brown sugar, lime juice, salt, cinnamon and thyme until melted.
Peel the pineapple, cut as you like and poke with a fork. Place on a baking sheet and coat with butterscotch on both sides.
Grill with the lid closed about 3-4 minutes per side, turning and flipping until grill marks form and the pineapple is soft.
Brush on more butterscotch, rest, then top with ice cream and pistachios.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Recipe from @trevorthrussell on Instagram.

recipes.title: Hard-Boiled Egg Chocolate Mousse
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender and blitz until smooth.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to set.
recipes.notes: Hard boil the eggs the day before so the egg smell is gone. Original from @feelgoodfoodie. Recipe from @louisemccormickwalsh on Instagram.

recipes.title: High-Protein Banana Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 cup chocolate protein powder (or cocoa powder)
Chocolate chips (no sugar added), to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 350F.
Mix everything together and pour into an 8x8 Pyrex dish.
Bake 12 minutes, pull out and gently tap on the counter to help it set, then bake another 10-12 minutes.
Let cool a bit before serving.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Katie Moore on Instagram.

recipes.title: High-Protein Honey Flan
ingredients: a couple dashes of vanilla extract
steps: Heat the milk with the honey on the stove.
Pour the warm milk into a bowl with the eggs, add vanilla, and whisk together.
Place the bowl inside a larger pot with water in it.
Heat on medium for about 20 minutes, then remove.
Chill before serving if desired.
recipes.notes: Creator says it has 33 g protein total. Water-bath method details (lid, water depth) are not specified. Recipe from @tice on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Chocolate Hazelnut Spread
ingredients: 1/2 tsp sea salt, plus more to taste
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F. Roast the hazelnuts on a sheet pan about 10 minutes, stirring after 5.
While still hot, rub them in a clean kitchen towel to remove most of the skins.
Blend the nuts, starting low and gradually increasing speed, until a nut butter forms.
Microwave the chocolate in 30-second intervals until melted.
Blend in the chocolate, vanilla and salt.
recipes.notes: Sweetness comes from the chocolate; add sweetener if using sugar-free chocolate. Recipe from @mishkamurphy on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Hazelnut Nougat Chocolate Bars
ingredients: 1-2 tsp coconut oil (if the processor is weak)
steps: Blend the dates, 1 cup hazelnuts and salt until smooth and chewy; spread evenly in a lined tray.
Blend 1/2 cup hazelnuts into a creamy paste (add coconut oil if needed), then blend in the melted chocolate, maple syrup and vanilla.
Spread the chocolate cream over the nougat and sprinkle with more hazelnuts.
Freeze about 1 hour until firm and cut into rectangular bars.
Melt the coating chocolate with the coconut oil over low heat; dip each bar.
Top with fleur de sel and chopped hazelnuts before it sets.
Freeze 10-15 minutes to harden.
recipes.notes: Makes a good homemade gift. Recipe from Youssef Maazami on Instagram.

recipes.title: Honeydew Drops (Reverse Spherification Apple Spheres)
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups (1,075 g) distilled or purified water
Green apple extract, to taste (water soluble)
steps: Blend the sodium alginate with the distilled water until fully dispersed. Cover and refrigerate at least 2-3 hours or overnight until clear and bubble-free.
Mix the filling water, sugar, calcium lactate gluconate and citric acid until dissolved; add the rest of the water, apple extract and food coloring.
Divide among eight sphere molds and freeze overnight until solid.
Stir the holding liquid ingredients together until dissolved, flavor lightly with apple extract, and refrigerate.
One at a time, lower a frozen sphere into the alginate bath for 7-8 minutes, rotating gently. The inside stays frozen.
Rinse the sphere in cold filtered water for 30-60 seconds.
Move to the cold holding liquid in a single layer and refrigerate until the centers fully thaw.
recipes.notes: Needs specialty ingredients (calcium lactate gluconate, sodium alginate). Recipe from @Mary Castro on Instagram.

recipes.title: Kahlua Coffee Ice Cream Party Punch
ingredients: whipped cream and chocolate shavings, optional
steps: Whisk the boiling water, espresso powder and sugar until combined. Chill at least 30 minutes (can be done the day before).
In a large punch bowl combine the milk, Kahlua and coffee mixture, then add the ice cream scooped or cut into chunks and stir.
Set out cups and a ladle, with whipped cream and chocolate shavings if desired.
recipes.notes: Only about 1 cup of Kahlua for the whole batch, and it can be left out. 9 oz Chinet crystal cups suggested (sponsored). Ice cream melts over hours and still tastes great. Recipe from kate strickler on Instagram.

recipes.title: Knafeh Ice Cream
steps: Cut the kadaif into 1/2 inch pieces. Heat the coconut oil over low heat, add the kadaif and stir constantly until it starts to brown. Add the powdered sugar and keep stirring until it caramelizes and the noodles are golden. Turn off the heat, stir in the rose water and set aside.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks, add the condensed milk and whip another minute.
Move half the mixture to a bowl and fold in the pistachio butter.
Fill an English cake (loaf) pan halfway with both mixtures, sprinkle on a layer of kadaif, add the rest of the mixtures and smooth, then top with kadaif.
Cover and freeze 6 hours or overnight.
recipes.notes: Served with pistachio and coconut condensed milk drizzle and extra pistachios. Recipe from @maayan.moss on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lebanese Nights (Layali Lubnan)
steps: Make the syrup: combine water, a lot of sugar, rose water and lemon juice; once the sugar dissolves, set aside to cool.
Whisk the milk, coarse semolina, sugar and a splash of rose water over medium heat until thickened to a custard texture.
Spread the custard evenly in a tray and let it cool completely.
Spread sugar-free whipped cream over the custard and top with crushed pistachios.
Serve with a drizzle of the rose syrup.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities in the reel; the full recipe is linked in the creator bio. Recipe from Antony Khoury (Love at First Bite) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Magnolia Snap Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups loosely packed fragrant magnolia petals
Optional: 1 tbsp frozen grated magnolia petals
Optional: sugary petals saved from the syrup, for the center
steps: Wash the petals and discard the reproductive parts; petals will shrink and brown, which is normal.
Cook the petals with the water and sugar into a thick syrup; save some of the jammy petals.
Cream the vegan butter with the brown sugar, then add vanilla (or nocino) and the syrup.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and the grated frozen magnolia petals if using.
Shape a ball of dough into a nest, fill with a few syrup petals, close it up.
Roll in a bowl of sugar and cinnamon (she also adds grated spicebush).
Bake at 350F for 11 minutes.
recipes.notes: Syrup cooking time not stated. Use unsprayed, correctly identified magnolia. Recipe from @alexisnikole on Instagram (Alexis Nikole).

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Tiramisu
steps: Mix milk, condensed milk, mango puree and cardamom for the dipping liquid.
Whip the cream layer: heavy cream, mango puree, condensed milk, cardamom and cream cheese.
Dip ladyfingers in the mango milk and layer with the cream; repeat and chill.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Full recipe with amounts is on creator's site (comment "mango" or "recipe"). Cream cheese gives tang; could swap for a non-cheese option. Recipe from @shreyawalia on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mango Sago
steps: Simmer the sago pearls on low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid clumping.
Turn off the heat, cover with a lid and let sit 10-15 minutes to finish cooking.
Rinse and strain to remove excess gel.
Combine mango, coconut jelly, sago, evaporated milk, coconut milk and condensed milk.
Refrigerate at least 3-4 hours; overnight is best.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given in the reel. Recipe from @11354686 (My Nguyen) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice Rolls
steps: Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear, then soak in water for at least 1 hour.
Cook the rice in 1 1/4 cups water in a rice cooker or on the stove.
Warm coconut milk and sugar in a pot over medium heat until just warmed; keep warm.
Mix rice with 2/3 of the coconut mixture and let soak in 15-20 minutes.
Slice mangos thinly. Run a rice paper sheet under the faucet and lay it down; add sesame seeds, 3-5 mango slices and a couple spoonfuls of rice. Fold up like a burrito.
Pour the remaining coconut mixture into a dipping bowl and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Use very ripe mango. Recipe from @8205220556 (Alexa Santos) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Masala Chai Creme Brulee
ingredients: 570 double cream (heavy whipping cream; unit not stated in caption)
steps: Whisk the egg yolks, whole egg and sugar together until combined.
Add the tea bags, spices and vanilla to the cream and heat on low about 10 minutes until it starts bubbling. Strain.
Gradually whisk the hot cream into the eggs; do not add all at once or the eggs scramble.
Strain again into ramekins. Set them in a baking dish and fill it halfway with boiling water.
Bake at 180C (about 355F) for 30-40 minutes, until the custards wobble slightly in the middle.
Cool, then chill in the fridge overnight or at least 2 hours.
Sprinkle sugar on top and caramelize with a blowtorch before serving.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Couffee on Instagram. Cream unit is not stated; likely ml.

recipes.title: Masala Chai Ice Cream Sandwiches
steps: Simmer ginger, cardamom, tea, brown sugar and 1/2 cup water until reduced to 1/4 cup; cool.
Whip double cream with the chai syrup and condensed milk until thick.
Lay a layer of Parle-G biscuits in an 8x8 pan, pour in the cream mix, and top with another layer of biscuits.
Freeze overnight, cut and serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Parle-G are available at Indian supermarkets. Recipe from @renesubash on Instagram.

recipes.title: Milk Pudding Bites
steps: Pour half of the milk into a pot with the sugar and mix.
Mix the cornstarch into the other half of the milk.
Cook the milk and sugar on medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes.
Slowly pour in the cornstarch mixture, stirring until thick.
Pour into a container and chill in the fridge for 1 hour.
Cut into bite-sized pieces and coat in coconut shreds.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are in the full recipe linked in her bio. Swap milk for coconut milk if lactose intolerant. Recipe from @tiffycooks on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mud of Heaven (Wahal al-Janneh) Lebanese Milk Pudding
steps: Crush the mastic and granulated sugar together to a fine sand in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, cream and cornflour in a very clean pot until lump-free.
Stir constantly over medium heat 12-15 minutes until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
Add the mastic sugar and the rose and orange blossom waters; stir hard 1 minute and remove from heat.
Pour into a serving dish and scatter pistachios while hot so they form a crust; cool, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Make the atter: boil sugar and water 5 minutes, add orange blossom water and lemon juice, boil 5 more minutes until it thickens; cool.
Serve cold with coconut, atter and rose petals.
recipes.notes: Use a very clean pot and spoon; residues can be tasted. Mastic is essential. Recipe from Sunday Kitchen (Sofra) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Nutella Sea Salt Fudge
steps: Add condensed milk, vanilla, chocolate chips, Nutella and butter to a glass bowl.
Microwave 15-20 seconds at a time, stirring between, until melted, smooth and starting to thicken (about 3 minutes total).
Line an 8x9 baking dish with parchment and spray with cooking spray.
Pour in the fudge and sprinkle with sea salt.
Refrigerate at least 2-3 hours to set; keep refrigerated.
recipes.notes: Can melt over a double boiler instead of the microwave. Cut into small pieces. Recipe from @Luke Brown on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oat Milk and Oat Pulp Truffles
steps: Blend the oats with the water, maple syrup and vanilla until very smooth.
Strain twice to avoid sliminess.
Mix the leftover pulp with peanut butter, maple syrup and a little salt and refrigerate.
Roll into balls and coat in cocoa powder.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Truffle amounts are on plantyou.com. Recipe from @plantyou on Instagram.

recipes.title: One-Ingredient Tangerine Sorbet
steps: Freeze the tangerine segments until solid.
Process the frozen segments in a food processor or high-powered blender, patiently; it goes from dry and crumbly to creamy in a few minutes.
Add a little sweetener if the tangerines are not sweet. Eat as is or top with shaved chocolate.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Pamela Salzman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Orange & Pomegranate Pates de Fruits
steps: Boil the juices with sugar and pectin until the mixture reaches 223F (106C).
Pour into a pan and let set into a firm jelly.
Cut and coat in a layer of sugar.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are in the creator's full recipe (comment RECIPE or link in profile). Recipe from @2017382164 (Lexi Harrison & Beth Sinclair, Crowded Kitchen) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Palestinian Nutella (Black Seed Spread)
steps: Add the seeds to a blender with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp olive oil and start blending.
Keep adding 2 tbsp each of olive oil and honey every minute of blending until you reach the desired consistency.
Use the strongest blender you have and blend 8-10 minutes, resting it every 2 minutes.
Adjust sweetness with honey, then store in a jar.
recipes.notes: Creator says it does not expire and takes a teaspoon each morning for its benefits (health claim, unverified). Use in desserts, cookies, cakes or on bread. Recipe from Mohammed Moosa on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pistachio Butter (Paste)
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 cup neutral oil (vegetable or coconut)
steps: Blend the pistachios on high about 2 minutes, scraping down the sides, until powdery then smooth.
Add the powdered sugar and salt.
Stream in the oil until it is as thick or thin as you like.
Let cool before sealing, then jar.
recipes.notes: Keeps a few weeks sealed, up to 4 weeks in the fridge. Don't close the jar while warm. Recipe from Connie Homayed Kazan on Instagram.

recipes.title: Raspberry Jam Bites
steps: Mash the raspberries and mix in the chia seeds and maple syrup.
Spread onto a non-stick surface in 3 circles and freeze about 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil, dip the raspberry rounds in it and freeze again.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @alicelovesbreakfast on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ripped Reeses Bowl
steps: Blend all five ingredients until thick and smooth like ice cream and serve as a bowl.
recipes.notes: Makes 1 large serving (120g protein, 900 cal); halve for a snack. Fairlife milk is ultra-filtered, high-protein milk. Recipe from Joseph Abell on Instagram.

recipes.title: Salty Vanilla Bean Honey Marshmallow Fluff
steps: Whip the egg whites and cream of tartar to stiff peaks.
Bring honey, sugar and water to 246F on the stove.
Slowly stream the hot syrup into the mixer while beating on low.
Add the vanilla and salt, then beat on high about 8 to 10 minutes until stable and fluffy.
Jar it up and enjoy within a week; no need to refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Adapted from momables.com; extra egg white makes it less sweet and more voluminous. Recipe from Alex Rosenberg-Rigutto on Instagram.

recipes.title: Self-Saucing Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Put a microwave-safe mug on a scale. Add the butter and melt in the microwave about 30 seconds.
Zero the scale and add the sugar, flour, cocoa and salt. Mix, add 20 g boiling water and mix to a smooth batter.
Smooth the batter flat, sprinkle over the 10 g sugar and 5 g cocoa, then gently pour on the 25 g boiling water without mixing it into the batter.
Microwave on LOW for about 5 minutes until the sponge has risen slightly and is firm to the touch with sauce visible around the edge. Timing varies by microwave, so check early.
Serve with a big scoop of vanilla ice cream.
recipes.notes: Custard also works instead of ice cream. Contains butter, not cheese. Recipe from @eleanorwilkinson on Instagram.

recipes.title: Shole Zard (Persian Saffron Rice Pudding)
steps: Wash and drain the rice a few times; soak a few hours if you have time.
Bring the water to a boil in a non-stick pot, add the rice, reduce to low and simmer 1 hour (1 hr 30 min if not soaked) until the grains fall apart when squeezed.
Stir in the saffron, butter, cardamom and finally the sugar; bring back to a boil, then simmer on low 15 minutes until thickened.
Take off the heat and stir in the rose water.
Pour into bowls, cool slightly, cover and chill at least 3 hours until set.
Garnish with almonds, pistachios, cinnamon and rose petals.
recipes.notes: Traditionally made in big batches to give away during Ramadan and Nowruz. Recipe from Mana (Plant-Based Persian Recipes) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spiced Coconut Caramel
ingredients: 1 tsp white miso paste (optional, or a pinch of salt)
steps: Combine the coconut milk, sugar, cinnamon, star anise and vanilla in a pan and simmer over low-medium heat until the caramel reduces and thickens to a deep rich dark color.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the butter and miso (or a pinch of salt).
Drizzle over vanilla ice cream.
recipes.notes: Part 34 of the "All About the Sauce" series. Recipe from Thom Bateman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Stovetop Flan (2 servings)
steps: Put egg, yolk, salt and sugar in a jar and shake about 30 seconds. Add milk and shake lightly.
Strain through a fine sieve.
Warm gently in a pan on medium-low; do not overheat.
Divide between two ramekins or cups and pop bubbles on top with a lighter.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, reduce to low, add ramekins, and steam about 10 minutes until jiggly.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Heat sugar until light golden brown; add a little hot water to thin. Pour over the flan.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Caramel sugar amount not given. Recipe from @33854314752 (Andres, Real Food) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Strawberry Tanghulu
ingredients: 1/2 tsp baking soda (optional, for soaking strawberries)
steps: Optionally soak the strawberries in water with 1/2 tsp baking soda, or just wash them. Pat dry.
Thread 1-3 strawberries onto each bamboo skewer.
Bring the water and sugar to a boil in a pot and cook, without stirring, to 150C / 300F on a candy thermometer. Or test a spoonful in cold water; it should harden immediately.
Prepare a bowl of ice water. Remove the syrup from the heat.
Dip each skewer in the syrup, then straight into the ice water. Eat right away.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Ma'ayan Moss on Instagram. Eat right away; the shell softens in humidity.

recipes.title: Sweet Cheese Rolls (Halawet el Jibn)
ingredients: 2 tbsp orange blossom water or rose water
steps: Put the water and sugar in a pot over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add the mozzarella and keep stirring; when it begins to melt and sizzle, gradually add the fine semolina, stirring constantly on strong heat until the semolina absorbs the liquid.
When the mixture is thick, stretchy and heavy, stir in the orange blossom or rose water.
Turn out onto parchment paper or plastic and let it cool a little. Grease the top with a spoonful of ghee and spread it out slowly.
Once cool, fill with cream (ashta), roll, and top with Aleppo pistachios.
Pour or serve with sugar syrup.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Contains mozzarella (cheese). Method translated from the Arabic audio; spreading thickness, rolling and syrup recipe not specified. Recipe from Nour Ghazall - نور غزال on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F.
Mix all ingredients in a bowl until no clumps remain.
Pour the batter into a lined baking dish.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes; they should look slightly undercooked when removed.
Let them firm up before eating.
recipes.notes: Caption frames it as a luteal-phase dessert; that health claim is the creator's. Recipe from @candiceray on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Brownies
steps: Mix the ingredients together (sweet potato, nut butter, cocoa, maple syrup or honey), fold in dark chocolate chips.
Bake (time and temperature not given in the reel).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts and bake time are on the blog: https://organicallyaddison.com/sweet-potato-brownies/. Recipe from Addison LaBonte on Instagram.

recipes.title: Triple Coconut Cream Pie
ingredients: 2 oz unsweetened chip or large-shred coconut
steps: Make the dough, crimp the edges, line with parchment and pie weights, and par-bake until bottom and sides are golden brown (can be done ahead).
Make the coconut pastry cream from the milk, coconut milk, coconut, vanilla bean, eggs, sugar, flour and butter (method not shown; cook as a standard pastry cream).
Spread the pastry cream into the crust.
Whip cream with sugar, vanilla and salt, then pipe generous swirls over the pie.
Top with toasted coconut flakes and white chocolate shavings.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Ingredient amounts from caption; crust-dough and pastry-cream method steps are not shown, full recipe at femalefoodie.com. Recipe from @femalefoodie on Instagram (courtesy of Dahlia Bakery).

recipes.title: Tropical Thick Greek Yogurt Trio (Ube, Mango, Coconut)
ingredients: fresh mango, granola, mint and extra condensed milk, to serve
steps: Split the yogurt evenly into 3 bowls.
Fold 1-2 tsp ube flavoring into one bowl (more for stronger flavor).
Fold the mango puree into the second bowl.
Fold the sweetened condensed coconut milk into the third bowl.
Layer the three flavors evenly in a yogurt strainer with the press plate and spring.
Strain in the fridge for 48 hours to remove the whey.
Serve with fresh mango, granola, mint and a drizzle of condensed milk.
recipes.notes: Coconut cream can replace the condensed coconut milk. Save the whey for smoothies. A yogurt strainer is needed. Recipe from Rachel (eatsbyrachel) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Turkish Delight (Lokum)
ingredients: 3½ cups (700 g) granulated or caster sugar
½-¾ tsp finely grated lemon zest (optional)
steps: Line an 8x8-inch pan with plastic wrap. Mix the coating ingredients and dust the pan lightly.
In a heavy saucepan combine sugar, water, lemon juice and cream of tartar. Heat over medium-low, stirring gently until the sugar dissolves. Do not boil yet.
Whisk the cornstarch with the cold water until smooth. Take the pan off the heat and whisk in the slurry.
Sprinkle the gelatin over the surface and whisk to disperse.

Return to medium heat, bring to a boil, then keep at a steady simmer 20-25 minutes, stirring often, until thick, glossy and translucent, and thick ribbons falling from the whisk briefly hold. Colour should be light golden.
Remove from heat and stand 5 minutes, then stir in rose water and lemon zest.
Pour into the pan, tap to level, cover loosely with parchment and set at room temperature 4-5 hours or overnight.
Turn out the slab, dust generously, cut with a lightly oiled knife, toss pieces in the coating and shake off excess.
recipes.notes: Rose water is an acquired taste; swap in other flavors if you like. Store at room temperature in an airtight container layered with parchment, best within 2-3 days. Recipe from Mary Castro on Instagram.

recipes.title: Vegan Mango Coconut Rose Creme Brulee
ingredients: 300 ml mango pulp (Kesar or Alphonso preferred)
steps: Whisk the mango pulp, coconut milk, rose water, vanilla, sugar and cornflour in a saucepan until no lumps remain.
Cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until thickened enough to coat the back of a spatula. Off the heat, mix in the vegan butter.
Divide among ramekins and refrigerate at least 5 hours.
Shortly before serving, melt the sugar over medium-low heat until smooth and just brown, pour onto baking paper to cool completely, then grind into coarse granules.
Spoon the sugar over the custards and torch or grill. Let set a few minutes.
Garnish with dried rose petals and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Serves 4, depending on ramekin size. Recipe from Rishi Nanavati on Instagram.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Tofu with Sriracha Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 block extra firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 tbsp avocado oil or other neutral oil
steps: Toss the tofu in a bowl with the oil, soy, nutritional yeast, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper; add the starch 1/2 tbsp at a time until fully coated.
Spread in an even layer in the air fryer and cook at 400F for 12-15 minutes, shaking once halfway.
Mix all the sauce ingredients until smooth.
Serve the tofu with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Air fryer version of the creator's viral crispy tofu. Recipe from Kristi Roeder on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Vanilla Almond Butter
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F. Bake the almonds on a baking sheet for 10 minutes, stirring halfway.
Cool for 5 minutes, then blend in a food processor, scraping down the sides.
Add the maple syrup, cinnamon, vanilla and salt and blend about 15 minutes until smooth and runny, stopping every few minutes to stir. Let cool.
Store in an airtight jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks.
recipes.notes: Warm nuts blend more easily. Recipe by @healthygirlkitchen, shared by Vegan Recipes on Instagram.

recipes.title: Korean Mayak Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool in an ice bath.
Chop the green onion, ginger, red chili, garlic and onion into a container. Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, sesame seeds and a little water.
Peel the eggs and submerge them in the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Eat with rice and a spoonful of the marinade.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given in the video. Yolks turn jammy and savory. Recipe from kevin from KWOOWK on Instagram.

recipes.title: Microwave Popcorn in a Silicone Popper
ingredients: popcorn kernels (up to the fill notch)
steps: Fill the popper with kernels up to the notch and spray with oil.
Put on the lid and microwave for a few minutes until popped.
Dump into a bowl, spray with oil again so seasoning sticks, and season.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No times given; his seasoning is a homemade cheesy garlic one (contains cheese, skip). Recipe from @Mike Greenfield on Instagram.

recipes.title: Roasted Maple Seeds (Helicopters)
steps: Gather the seeds and remove the brown papery shells: break off one end, peel down the side, break off the other end.
Boil the shelled seeds in water for 5-10 minutes.
Strain and pat dry.
Saute in a skillet or roast in the oven with oil or butter until brown.
Season with salt or your choice of seasoning.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Eat raw when green; cooking removes bitterness in brown seeds. Positively identify maple first. Recipe from @Laura Monnett on Instagram.

recipes.title: Soaked & Roasted Pumpkin Seed Butter
ingredients: 250 g raw pumpkin seeds (pepitas), about 2 cups
1-2 tsp neutral oil or pumpkin seed oil (optional)
steps: Soak the seeds overnight (8-12 hours), drain, then dry really well.
Roast at 170C / 340F for 15 to 20 minutes until fragrant.
Blend with the salt until creamy, adding 1-2 tsp oil only if it needs help turning smooth.
Blend for a long time, 10-15 minutes in a food processor, in stages, scraping down the sides and letting the machine rest.
recipes.notes: Keeps about 2-3 weeks in the fridge. Flavor ideas: cinnamon and vanilla, chili and lime, miso and sesame. Recipe from Raquel | Midwife on Instagram.

recipes.title: Spicy Korean Mayak (Drug) Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs 7 minutes, then cool in an ice bath and peel.
Chop the onion, jalapeno and green onion and mince the garlic.
Mix the gochujang, water, soy sauces, honey, pepper flakes, MSG and sesame seeds, then stir in the chopped vegetables.
Put the eggs in a container, pour over the marinade and cover with a paper towel so the eggs stay submerged.
Close the lid and refrigerate up to a week.
Serve over rice with more marinade.
recipes.notes: Includes a sponsor plug for a recipe-saving app. Recipe from Matt H. on Instagram.

recipes.title: Strawberry Mango Fruit Roll-Ups
ingredients: water, only if fruit is not frozen
steps: Preheat oven to 175F.
Blend strawberries, mango, lemon, honey and a little water if fruit is not frozen until very soupy.
Line pans with parchment and spread the puree very thin and evenly to the edges with a spoon.
Bake about 3 hours; done when it lifts from the sides easily.
Cut and roll up.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Mango adds sweetness without sugar. Makes about three pans. Recipe from @christyisable on Instagram.

recipes.title: Brazilian Lemonade
steps: Blend the quartered limes with enough water to cover them.
Strain out the lime peel and return the liquid to the blender.
Add the sweetened condensed milk and ice and blend.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Water quantity not stated. Recipe from @mamainthekitchen on Instagram.

recipes.title: Caramelized Banana Syrup (for Affogato or Lattes)
steps: Cook the butter and bananas over medium heat to a mushy melt, about 5 minutes.
Add the brown sugar and simmer on low for 5 minutes.
Add the water and simmer another 10 minutes.
Blend, let cool, then stir in the vanilla extract.
recipes.notes: Use super ripe bananas. Pour over ice cream with espresso for an affogato or add to lattes and matcha. Quantities from caption; yield is an estimate. Recipe from @vic lauren on Instagram.

recipes.title: Chia Lemon Electrolyte Drink
steps: Combine everything in a glass or jar.
Let the chia hydrate for 5 minutes (or make it overnight).
recipes.notes: Intended for suhoor during Ramadan. Health claims are the creator's. Recipe from Abdul Azeem on Instagram.

recipes.title: Cocktail Spheres (Leprechaun Balls)
steps: Combine the vodka, apple schnapps, simple syrup, White Claw and calcium lactate; add glitter for sparkle.
Pour into ice molds and freeze until fully solid.
Form the spheres following the creator's pinned spherification tutorial.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts are as stated for the video's double batch; the single-batch ratio is not given. The spherification bath step is in her pinned tutorial, not in this reel. Contains alcohol. Recipe from Reyna Edmonds on Instagram.

recipes.title: Ginger Turmeric Immune Shot
steps: Blend the ginger and turmeric with 1 cup of water, then pour into a pot with 3 1/4 cups more water (or grate them into a pot with 1 liter water).
Add the black pepper and cayenne, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes.
Cool and store in glass jars in the fridge.
Before drinking, add lemon juice, olive oil and honey, shake, and serve.
recipes.notes: Add heat-sensitive ingredients cold. Health claims are the creator's. Recipe from @Shane Carpenter on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Electrolyte Powder
ingredients: 75 g sodium chloride (sea salt, blended to a powder)
Or by volume: 1/2 cup sea salt, 1/10 cup potassium chloride, 2/5 cup magnesium malate
Optional: dried fruit powder (strawberry, blueberry, raspberry)
Optional: dash of maple syrup or honey per drink
steps: Blend the sea salt until powdery.
Combine the salt, potassium chloride and magnesium malate (and fruit powder if using) in a jar.
Shake well to mix.
Sprinkle some into a glass of water to drink (amount per glass not stated).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Makes 30 servings; double for 60. Serving amount not given, and potassium/magnesium intake matters, so check with a doctor if you take medications. Recipe from @candiceray on Instagram.

recipes.title: Jamaican Carrot Juice with Guinness
ingredients: 120 ml full-fat coconut milk or coconut cream
steps: Blend the carrots with the water until smooth.
Strain through a fine sieve or cloth, pressing well; you should get about 700-750 ml juice.
Add the Guinness, coconut milk, condensed milk, vanilla, nutmeg, cinnamon, ginger and salt to the juice.
Whisk or blend gently until combined.
Refrigerate a few hours so the flavors come together; stir before serving as the sediment settles.
Serve cold.
recipes.notes: Condensed milk can size not stated. Part of a Jamaican Classics series. Recipe from Bill Allison on Instagram.

recipes.title: Karkade (Egyptian Hibiscus Tea)
steps: Put the dried hibiscus in a large bowl, cover with a little water and rinse once only, then drain.
Bring 1.5 L of water to a boil, add the 90 g hibiscus and the mint.
When it bubbles, reduce to a simmer, squeeze in fresh orange juice and simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Strain, keeping only the liquid.
While still hot, stir in sugar until dissolved.
Chill the base in the fridge; it is concentrated and not ready to drink.
To serve, add orange slices, lightly crushed mint and ice to a glass or pitcher, add the base and dilute with water to taste. Shake.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Orange and mint can be omitted for pure hibiscus flavor. Sugar amount not given. Also popular in Sudan and Jamaica. Recipe from @ahmadalzahabi on Instagram (Ahmad Alzahabi, Ramadan Chronicles Pt. 16).

recipes.title: Karkade and Pineapple Juice (Sudanese)
steps: Boil the karkade for about 5 minutes to make a concentrate.
Blend the pineapple with water, the karkade concentrate and the sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Serve cold.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts for water and milk not given. Recipe from Ahmed Abdin (A3bdin) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Lemon Mint Drink (Limonana)
steps: Add the whole lemons, mint leaves (two per lemon), Sprite, the ginger and sweetener to a blender.
Add ice and blend; the mixture is concentrated so the ice waters it down.
Serve.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No quantities given. Using the whole lemon makes a big difference, says the creator. Recipe from Ahmad Alzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Mint Vinegar Syrup Drink (Sekanjabin)
steps: Combine the sugar and water and bring to a boil.
Add the mint leaves and turn off the heat.
Steep for 15 minutes, then strain out the mint.
Stir in the white wine vinegar.
Mix a spoonful of syrup into a glass of cold water to serve.
recipes.notes: Syrup-to-water ratio for serving is not stated; adjust to taste. Part 1 of a series on refreshing drinks from around the world. Recipe from Roice Bethel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Non-Alcoholic Hibiscus Margarita
ingredients: sugar and dried hibiscus flowers for the rim
steps: Simmer the water with the cinnamon and cloves for about 7 minutes.
Add the dried hibiscus flowers and sugar and simmer another 7 minutes. Transfer to a glass and let cool.
Add lime juice, NA tequila, NA Cointreau and hibiscus juice to a shaker with ice and shake.
Rim glasses with sugar and dried hibiscus, pour over ice and garnish with cinnamon sticks.
recipes.notes: Creator uses Lyres NA agave blanco and orange spirits. Recipe from @oliviannoceda on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oleo-Saccharum Lemonade
ingredients: granulated sugar (twice the volume of the zest)
steps: Zest only the thin yellow skin of the lemons, avoiding the white pith.
Combine the zest with twice as much granulated sugar and muddle until the sugar pulls out the oil, forming oleo-saccharum.
Add water heated to about 150F to dissolve the sugar and make a syrup, then strain and squeeze out every last bit.
Juice the zested lemons.
Combine the syrup, lemon juice and still or sparkling water; use more syrup for sweeter, less water for stronger.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Exact quantities and final ratios are shown on screen only, not spoken. The syrup also works as a base for cocktails. Recipe from OsoHuman on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peach & Carrot Deli Container Mocktail
ingredients: 1/3 cup water mixed with electrolyte powder (white peach)
steps: Blend 1 peach, juice of 1 lime, ginger, carrot juice and 2 cups water until emulsified. Strain through a fine mesh strainer. Keeps in the fridge up to a week.
In a 32 oz deli container, add the diced peach, diced lime, mint and honey. Muddle together.
Fill the container with ice, add 1/3 cup concentrate, and top with electrolyte water (or sparkling water).
recipes.notes: Original recipe lists 2 peaches and 2 limes total across the concentrate and drink. Over 50 mocktail recipes on her substack. Recipe from @olivia noceda on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peaches and Cream Agua Fresca
steps: Add the peaches, evaporated milk, sour cream, cinnamon, condensed milk and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve over lots of ice.
recipes.notes: Pick ripe peaches that are slightly firm but spring back when pressed. Can sizes not given. Recipe from Jose Xiloj on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sage, Lavender and Mint Lemonade
ingredients: Fresh mint (spearmint, apple mint or tulsi)
steps: Fill a 1/2 gallon jar 1/2 to 3/4 full with fresh sage and mint, then top with room temperature water. Refrigerate overnight.
Next day, pour all but about a cup of the infusion (including herbs) into a blender; adding it all may overflow.
Add the lavender simple syrup and lemon or lime juice and blend on high for about 30 seconds.
Strain the herbs back into the jar, pressing out all the liquid.
Pour over ice or chill, and add honey if you want it sweeter.
recipes.notes: A cold infusion brings out astringent and diuretic benefits; a hot infusion brings out diaphoretic ones. Recipe from @42317736576 (Rooted Remembrance) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Sweet-Scent Spice Tea
steps: Add all the spices and the orange juice to 1 cup of water.
Simmer for 10 minutes and strain.
Drink 1-2 cups daily.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Spice amounts are not given. Claims about scent are unproven; fenugreek is not advised in pregnancy. Recipe from Ezgi Aslan on Instagram.

recipes.title: Thai Milk Tea with Chewy Boba
ingredients: syrup for storing the pearls (type not specified)
steps: Boil the raw tapioca pearls at a medium boil for about 30 minutes.
Turn off the heat, cover with a lid and steep for another 30 minutes.
Rinse off excess starch, then put the pearls in a syrup so they stay moist.
Steep ¼ cup tea leaves in 3 cups of water and strain through a fine strainer.
Make the creamer by mixing equal parts heavy whipping cream and sweetened condensed milk.
Add pearls and syrup to a glass, pour in the tea and ice, and top with the cream mixture.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Syrup type and quantities beyond the tea ratio are in the creator's DM recipe. Her claim that stores use different pearls is hers. Recipe from Roice Bethel on Instagram.

recipes.title: Creamed Honey
steps: Empty the crystallized honey into a bowl.
Beat with a hand mixer about 5 minutes, adding cinnamon if you like.
Taste; if still grainy, mix a bit longer.
Jar it and store on a shelf or counter.
recipes.notes: Use it on toast or pancakes, or jar several as gifts. Recipe by @ellie.bagwell, shared by The Recipe Book on Instagram.

recipes.title: Crispy Chilli Oil (Chilli Crisp)
ingredients: 15 g Korean gochugaru (or more chilli flakes)
steps: Slice the garlic and shallots on a mandoline so they are the same thickness.
Prep the spices, and the chillies separately.
Fry the garlic and shallots in the oil until golden; it takes several minutes before they color, then burns quickly. Strain and keep the oil.
Add the spices to the strained oil and sizzle 3-4 minutes until bubbling.
Meanwhile put the chillies in a heatproof bowl with the salt, sugar, MSG, vinegar, peanuts and sesame seeds.
Turn off the heat, rest the oil 2 minutes, then pour it over the chilli mixture and stir.
Crush the crispy shallots and garlic and stir them back in.
Rest, ideally 24 hours; stir before each use.
recipes.notes: Makes about 2 x 300 ml jars. Chinese dried chillies are mild but add color and fragrance. Recipe from verna on Instagram.

recipes.title: DIY Seed Protein Powder
steps: Blend everything until a fine powder (a strong blender helps).
Sieve if you want it smoother, or leave as is for smoothies.
Add to smoothies, oatmeal or yogurt.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Creator says this lasts about three weeks. Her 'protein' claim is not measured. Recipe from Olivia Lathwell on Instagram.

recipes.title: Egyptian Fish Marinade (Tadbeela)
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper (or mix of green and red)
Fish, such as tilapia (bolti), fresh or frozen
Flour or coating for dredging (audio unclear)
steps: Blend the garlic, parsley, pepper, spices and lemon juice, leaving some chunks.
Coat the fish in the marinade and rest, even up to a day ahead.
Right before frying, dredge the fish and put it into the hot oil immediately.
Fry in a shallow layer of oil on medium heat, turning often, until golden and crisp on both sides.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Works for fried or grilled fish. The Arabic narration is Egyptian dialect and a couple of words (garlic, dredge coating) were unclear in the transcript. Recipe from Nadia Elsayed on Instagram.

recipes.title: Falafel
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight, then drain.
Add chickpeas, onion, garlic, cilantro and parsley to a food processor.
Add baking powder, salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric and a touch of cornstarch.
Process, scraping down the sides, to a fine paste.
Scoop with an ice cream scoop into oil at about 350F.
Fry a couple of minutes until golden; serve with pita, vegetables and tahini sauce.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. 'Garlic' is inferred from a garbled transcript word (likely 'garlic'); no amounts given. Creator notes falafel originated in Egypt with fava beans; Palestinians use chickpeas. More at thegoldenbalance.com. Recipe from @Ahmad Alzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fermented and Vinegar Pickled Cucumbers (Mekhallal)
ingredients: 2 tbsp (30g) sea salt or kosher salt, non-iodized
steps: Wash the cucumbers well, rub them under running water and let them dry. Trim off the blossom end (important) and optionally the stem end so they fit the jar.
Sanitize jars for fermenting by boiling them in shallow water for 12 minutes. For vinegar pickles a clean jar is enough.

Fermented: stir the salt into the water until fully dissolved (about 3% salt; range is 2-5%). Pack cucumbers with garlic, dill, peppercorns and bay leaves, and pour the brine over so everything is submerged.
Vinegar: simmer the water, vinegar, salt and sugar until dissolved, then cool completely. Pack cucumbers with garlic, dill, chili flakes and mustard seeds and pour the cooled brine over.
Seal and leave on the shelf in a dark place for about 1 week, then refrigerate.
Fermented pickles must stay refrigerated after the first week. Vinegar pickles can stay on the shelf until opened, then refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Fermented is better for Arabic dishes like shawarma and falafel; vinegar pickles go with burgers and crispy chicken. Fermentation is the probiotic option; vinegar kills probiotics. Recipe from Zaid Dough on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fermented Fire Cider (Brine Method)
steps: Make the saltwater brine and stir so the salt begins to dissolve while you prep.
Slice lemons and onions as thin as possible; blend horseradish, ginger and turmeric; chop garlic and hot peppers.
Add everything to a 64-ounce mason jar and pour in the brine; add a fermentation weight to keep it submerged and a fermentation lid.
Ferment for 7 days.
Strain; optionally stir in 1/4 cup raw apple cider vinegar and 1 cup honey.
Store in the fridge and use as needed.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Brine ratio and ingredient amounts not given in the reel (full recipe by DM). Method learned from Rose at @thenaturalhealthhut. Recipe from Blooming Earth Herbals on Instagram.

recipes.title: Fire Cider
ingredients: raw apple cider vinegar with the mother
steps: Rough chop the onion, whole lemon with rind, horseradish, ginger and jalapeño; add to a jar with thyme, cinnamon sticks, peppercorns and a little cayenne.
Add honey if using, then pour in raw apple cider vinegar to cover.
Let sit in a dark area for four weeks.
Strain out the solids and store the liquid in the fridge.
Take a shot whenever you feel sick.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given; garlic is listed in caption but not in voiceover. Use fresh horseradish and ACV with the mother. Recipe from Gabbi on Instagram, following Rosemary Gladstar's recipe.

recipes.title: Homemade Cultured Butter
steps: Stir the yogurt into the cream and leave in a warm place overnight until tangy and thick.
Refrigerate until completely cold.
Whip (a stand mixer helps) past whipped cream until the fat clumps and separates from the buttermilk.
Strain off the buttermilk and save it for baking.
Knead the butter in cold water, changing the water several times, until it runs clean; press out remaining water.
Add salt if you like, shape in baking paper (a sushi rolling mat helps), twist the ends and refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Cultured buttermilk can be used for bread. Quantities of cream not given. Recipe from Johnny Kyunghwo on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Sauerkraut
ingredients: salt, 2% of the cabbage weight (about 30 g in this batch)
steps: Shred the cabbage by mandoline or knife.
Weigh the cabbage and calculate 2% of that weight in salt.
Add the salt and scrunch with your hands 5-10 minutes until brine appears.
Pack tightly into a sterilized jar so the cabbage is submerged in the brine.
Close and leave on the side 3-4 days, burping daily.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Transcript says 'cabbage plus salt plus thyme' but that is likely 'time'. Recipe from Alexina on Instagram.

recipes.title: Homemade Za'atar (زعتر)
steps: Pick the branches, strip the leaves and wash them well.
Dry the leaves for about a day using a dehydrator.
Crush the dried leaves by rubbing them between your hands, which releases their oils.
Pass through a sieve for a finer texture.
Rub the za'atar with olive oil.
Add salt, sumac, lemon zest and toasted sesame and mix.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Caption mentions sage (ميرمية) as part of the Palestinian herb theme. Recipe from @Alya Younes on Instagram.

recipes.title: Honeysuckle Jelly
ingredients: honeysuckle blossoms, as many as you can gather
steps: Pick as many honeysuckle blossoms as possible and add to steaming hot water.
Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate overnight to infuse.
Strain through a fine strainer, squeezing out the juice, then strain again through a coffee filter until clear.
Heat the liquid in a pot, add 1 tbsp lemon juice and the pectin, then 4 cups sugar, and bring to a rolling boil.
Ladle into sterilized jars, wipe the rims, add lids and rings.
Process in a water bath to preserve; it will set as it cools.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Infusion can also be drunk as tea. Exact water and pectin quantities not given; follow the pectin package. Recipe from @savannahpaigehicks on Instagram (Savannah Paige Hicks).

recipes.title: Human Kibble (Meal Prep Rice and Bean Bowl)
steps: Start the rice on the stove since it takes the longest.
Boil the black beans and peas.
Chop the broccoli, carrots, zucchini and onions and saute in the biggest pot you have, seasoned with salt to draw out moisture.
Cook the eggs (at least one per serving).
Combine everything in a big bowl and portion out.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Amounts not given; full recipe via DM or pattyplates.com. Makes 10 portions in about an hour. Creator says pairs well with chicken or beef (optional). Recipe from Patrick Kong on Instagram.

recipes.title: Korean Marinated Eggs (Mayak Eggs)
ingredients: 1 tbsp gochugaru or red chili flakes
1 spicy red pepper or habanero, thinly sliced
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and gently lower in the eggs. Cook 6-7 minutes for jammy yolks.
Move the eggs to an ice bath, cool, then peel.
Stir all the remaining ingredients together in a large bowl.
Add the peeled eggs, making sure they are fully covered. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Remove the eggs and serve over cooked white rice with some marinade drizzled on top and kimchi on the side.
recipes.notes: Recipe from @Alexa Santos on Instagram.

recipes.title: Libyan Soup (Sharba Libiya)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped parsley (half at start, half at end)
1 tsp cayenne powder, or to taste
steps: Saute the onion in the olive and vegetable oils. Add the lamb and half the parsley and cook 5-10 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, turmeric, cayenne and salt.
Add the water and cook about 30 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and orzo and cook about 10 minutes.
Stir in the remaining parsley and the cilantro, then finish with the dried mint.
recipes.notes: Adjust amounts to taste; this is how the creator's household prefers it. Recipe from Dania's Cuisine on Instagram.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Root Earl Grey Lavender Tea Blend
steps: Combine the marshmallow root, Earl Grey and lavender in the listed ratio and store as a loose blend.
Steep as you would regular tea (brewing time not given).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Transcript says about a quarter part lavender; caption says 1 part. Marshmallow root smells weak but improves body. Recipe from @1310589912 (Deep Roots Herb School) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Nocino (Green Walnut Liqueur)
steps: Wear gloves, wash the green walnuts well and quarter them.
Put them in a jar and cover with the vodka or Everclear. Set by a sunny window; it turns black. Shake periodically.
After 40 days, make the syrup: cook sugar and water for 12 minutes and cool.
Combine the syrup with the liqueur (strain the walnuts) and store in the freezer.
recipes.notes: Straining step is implied, not shown. Served as a digestivo. Recipe from @Shereen Pavlides on Instagram (Fattoria Rossi family recipe).

recipes.title: One Batch of Lemons, Four Pantry Goodies
ingredients: sugar (half the weight of the chopped lemons)
steps: Wash lemons well; peel most of them like a potato and spread the peels on dehydrator trays.
Slice other lemons evenly and dehydrate them as slices.
Juice the peeled lemons, strain, and freeze in cube trays; later bag the cubes.
Chop the squeezed lemon bodies, weigh them, and mix with sugar at half that weight; stir occasionally until the sugar dissolves.
Strain and press out the lemon syrup; pour into jars.
Blend the dehydrated peels into lemon zest powder; store dried slices in a mason jar.
recipes.yield: Makes lemon zest powder, juice cubes, syrup, dried slices
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Dehydrator times and temperature not given. Recipe from Karolina on Instagram.

recipes.title: Oven "Sun-Dried" Tomatoes in Oil
steps: Heat the oven to 100C (about 210F). Slice the tomatoes and arrange on a tray lined with baking paper. Sprinkle evenly with the sea salt.
Bake 3 hours. Cool to room temperature.
Pack the herbs and dried tomatoes tightly in a glass jar and drizzle with olive oil until fully covered.
Close the lid and rest 24 hours before eating.
recipes.notes: Keeps up to 10 days in a dark, cool place (creator's guidance). Recipe from Rubi Michael on Instagram.

recipes.title: Peaches Canned in Sweet Tea
steps: Blanch the peaches in boiling water, transfer to an ice bath and peel off the skins.
Cut the peaches in half or slice them; keep in the ice bath while you brew the tea.
Brew sweet tea with the sugar and honey.
Fill mason jars with peach slices and top with sweet tea.
Process the jars (method and time not shown; follow a tested canning guide).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts or processing time given. Recipe from @Sasser House on Instagram.

recipes.title: Pickled and Fermented Green Almonds (مخلل ولوز أخضر مخمّر)
ingredients: salted water: 1 to 1.5 tbsp coarse salt per liter
steps: Wash the green almonds well in lukewarm water; use tender ones.
Use filtered water rather than tap water to avoid lime and chlorine.
Put the almonds in a sterilized jar with lemon slices, garlic, peppercorns, coriander seeds and bay leaves.
Mix vinegar with the water, then add the salt and sugar until dissolved, and pour over the almonds.
Seal tightly and keep in a dark place for one week. Refrigerate after opening to stop pickling.

Fermented version: warm some water and dissolve the salt, pierce the almonds with small holes, put them in the jar with the same aromatics, pour over the brine and ferment 2-3 weeks (caption cut off after this point).
(The remaining fermenting steps are cut off in the caption.)
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Creator says he preferred the pickled version to the fermented. Original Arabic caption is cut off in the fermented steps. Recipe from @302124764 (Moe Bayer) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: Up to 5 jalapenos (fewer for less heat)
A couple of chiles de arbol (optional)
steps: Saute the tomatillos and jalapenos in oil about 7 minutes until nicely charred.
Add onion and garlic and cook 4-5 minutes. Optionally add chiles de arbol and cook 2 minutes more.
Add the bouillon (or salt) and cook 1 minute, then add 1/4 cup water, stir and bring to a simmer.
Transfer everything to a blender with some of the cooking water, plenty of cilantro, more salt, and cumin and oregano if using. Blend.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Keeps up to two weeks in the fridge or longer. Onion and garlic amounts not given. Recipe from Alfredo Garcia on Instagram.

recipes.title: Syrian-Style Sour Lentil Soup (Adas bi Hamod)
ingredients: 1 cup cubed pumpkin, squash/zucchini or potato (optional)
steps: Wash the lentils very well until the water runs mostly clear. Add to a pot and cover with the 5 cups water.
Boil on medium about 20 minutes until soft, skimming foam and stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile squeeze the lemons, crush the garlic with 1 tsp salt, and peel and cut the pumpkin into small cubes.
Add the other 1 tsp salt, turmeric, pumpkin and crushed garlic. Cook about 15 minutes until the pumpkin is tender, adding water if too thick.
When the pumpkin is almost tender, add about 3/4 of the lemon juice, taste, and adjust with more lemon and salt.
Turn off the heat and stir in the olive oil. Serve with lemon, Aleppo pepper, olive oil and dry bread.
recipes.notes: Potato is the creator's personal favorite in place of pumpkin. Soup is kept unblended and chunky, though some blend it smooth. Recipe from Bayan’s kitchen 🥣 on Instagram.

recipes.title: Thai Crack Sauce
steps: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until the consistency you like.
recipes.notes: Yield about 12 oz (the video doubles it for 24 oz). Good on grilled chicken, steak, salmon, shrimp and scallops, or as salad dressing. Recipe from Jessica on Instagram.

recipes.title: Three Meal Prep Chicken Marinades
ingredients: 1/4 cup light soy sauce or GF tamari (60 g)
1 tbsp water, plus more to thin
3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs (1,300 g)
2 tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt, plus more to taste
zest of 1 lemon, juice of half
lots of fresh cracked black pepper
steps: Mix the marinade ingredients for your chosen flavor (for Harissa, blend the onion, tomatoes, parsley, garlic and yogurt first).
Coat chicken thighs and marinate.
Cook for meal prep (cooking time and temperature not given in the caption).
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. Cooking method not given; full recipes at link in creator's bio. Also good on tofu and other meats. Recipe from @242643152 (Mishka Murphy) on Instagram.

recipes.title: Toum (Garlic Sauce)
steps: Put the garlic in a blender and cover it with some of the neutral oil.
Add a hefty pinch of salt and blend to a thick paste.
Add the rest of the oil and a good amount of lemon juice.
Blend a couple of minutes with up and down motions until thick but spreadable.
recipes.notes: Some amounts weren't given in the video; check the reel. No amounts given. Keeps a couple of weeks in the fridge. Recipe from @Ahmad Alzahabi on Instagram.

recipes.title: Tunisian Harissa
steps: Put on gloves. Remove the tops of the chiles, cut down the side, remove the seeds and place in a large bowl.
Cover with lukewarm water and weigh down with a plate so they stay submerged. Soak 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Drain, then process the chiles with the garlic, oil, paprika and salt, scraping the sides, adding more oil and salt if needed, until a creamy paste.
Store in clean jars (microwave glass jars 2 minutes without lids first to sanitize).
recipes.notes: Tip: sanitizing jars helps it keep longer. Recipe from Ma'ayan Moss on Instagram.

recipes.title: Vanilla Plums (Canned Italian Plums)
steps: Make the simple syrup by combining sugar and water.
Place ground vanilla in the bottom of each jar.
Fill jars with halved, pitted plums and top with syrup, leaving 1/2 inch headspace; remove bubbles and push down floating plums.
Wipe rims clean (vinegar on a paper towel), seat lids and rings.
Process in a water bath canner 20 minutes for pints, 25 minutes for quarts.
Let sit at least a couple months before eating or gifting.
recipes.yield: Makes about 4 quarts of syrup's worth
recipes.notes: Ground vanilla is stronger than extract. Good in desserts or sorbet. Recipe from Cannon Kitchen on Instagram.
